titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The European System of Central Banks was created by the Maastricht Treaty to design, decide and implement the euro area's single monetary policy.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: As regards monetary policy, the key decision-making body of the ESCB is the Governing Council of the ECB.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: It is important to realise that, although only the six members of the Executive Board are appointed on a centralised European-wide basis, all members of the Governing Council are obliged to pursue the Treaty mandate of price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: They are appointed to the Council as individuals who share a collective obligation under the Treaty to maintain price stability in the euro area as a whole.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: This is absolutely necessary: with a unified single monetary policy, policy decisions must be made in a manner that reflects conditions across the euro area in its entirety.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: This pre-requisite was clearly recognised in the announcement of the main elements of the ESCB's monetary policy strategy in October: "[the Governing Council] will base its decisions on monetary, economic and financial developments in the euro area as a whole.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The single monetary policy will adopt a euro area-wide perspective; it will not react to specific regional or national developments."

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: A regular and frequent collegial discussion of the single monetary policy will inevitably foster an area-wide perspective, as members of the Governing Council exchange their views on the economic situation and the direction of policy focusing on the euro area as a whole.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: To guarantee that the single monetary policy is strictly focused on the primary objective of price stability in an effective and credible way, the Treaty has conferred considerable independence on the ESCB.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: In making monetary policy decisions, the Governing Council is not subject to political interference.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The Maastricht Treaty is based on the belief - confirmed by a substantial body of recent empirical economic research - that delegating monetary policy decisions to an independent institution with a clearly defined and specific mandate improves the quality of policy-making, results in more stable prices and therefore facilitates both sustainable real growth and lasting improvements in living standards, as I described a moment ago.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Such a delegation of the responsibility of monetary policy to an independent central bank therefore serves the interest of the public at large.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: As I will describe in a moment, the ESCB's mandate is clear and limited - it must maintain price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The ESCB's independence is crucial in achieving this objective, but the ESCB must also be prepared to explain to the public, in an encompassing manner, how its monetary policy has been geared to this goal.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The ESCB's independence and its primary objective of price stability are established in a Treaty that was subject to intense public scrutiny and debate.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The monetary policy strategy recently selected by the Governing Council has been designed with these commitments in mind.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The Maastricht Treaty stipulates that the "primary objective of the ESCB shall be to maintain price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: In the interests of transparency and accountability the Governing Council has agreed that the ESCB's chosen operational definition of price stability should be announced publicly.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: This announcement forms an important element of the overall monetary policy strategy, and constitutes a clear benchmark against which the public can properly judge the performance of the single monetary policy.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: It almost goes without saying that the Governing Council is fully committed to the maintenance of price stability on this definition.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The definition of price stability is intended to be a lasting quantification of the commitments made by the Governing Council in relation to its Treaty mandate.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The 'headline' measure of the HICP is the appropriate index to use in the definition.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The definition embodies a euro area measure of the price level, signalling the area-wide perspective that should be adopted in the conduct and assessment of monetary policy.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: This definition clearly signals that the Governing Council is symmetrically concerned about both inflation and deflation.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The phrase "below 2%' clearly delineates the rate of inflation in the HICP deemed consistent with price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The wording "year-on-year increases" implies that prolonged decreases in the HICP - that is to say deflation in the measured price index - would not be considered consistent with price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: In this way, the definition takes into account the threats posed by ongoing deflation in combination with nominal rigidities to the real economy.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: While periodic and transitory falls in the price level may be quite normal, and should not give rise to major concerns, a prolonged deflation is clearly inconsistent with any meaningful definition of price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Moreover, since nominal interest rates cannot fall below zero, the private expectation of a sustained fall in the price level may render the interest rate policy of the central bank rather ineffective.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: However, to make myself absolutely clear, this discussion of deflation refers to the definition of price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: I would not want to be seen as suggesting that a sustained deflation is an imminent threat.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: 'Headline' price inflation in the euro area has been reduced by the falls in international commodity prices that have stemmed, in part, from the crises in Asia and Russia.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Moreover, measures of 'core' inflation for the euro area - which exclude energy prices and other volatile components of the price index - are still higher than the headline rate.

frase: The measurement bias causes CPIs to overstate the 'true' rate of inflation.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: It is well- established central bank practice to allow for such measurement bias in the definition of price stability - for example, this approach was adopted by many national central banks in the euro area in recent years.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: However, I should emphasise that the HICP has been constructed with a view to minimising any measurement bias.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: It is therefore quite likely that the bias in the HICP is smaller than that observed in national CPIs.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: This might substantially reduce the risk of de facto deflation in euro area consumer prices while the measured price index continues to show an increase.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The Governing Council has also announced that price stability will be "maintained over the medium-term".

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: This announcement points to the need for the single monetary policy to have a forward-looking, medium-term orientation.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: It acknowledges the existence of short- term volatility in the price level that cannot be controlled by monetary policy alone.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The single monetary policy will react in an appropriate, measured and, when necessary, gradualist manner to economic disturbances that threaten price stability in the medium- term, rather than in a reflexive or unconscious way.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The ESCB can build on the success of its constituent NCBs in reducing inflation and achieving price stability during the convergence process in Stage Two of EMU.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Given the current generally benign inflation outlook in the euro area that is the product of these accomplishments, there is an understandable desire to 'lock-in' the current success by maintaining price stability as well as the apparent credibility of monetary policy, and ensure continuity with existing central bank practice.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: With price stability clearly defined in this manner, how should the ESCB proceed to maintain it?

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: In achieving and maintaining price stability - the primary objective of the Treaty - the choice of monetary policy strategy is vital.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The monetary policy strategy is, in the first place, important for the internal decision- making process of the ESCB - how the Governing Council will decide on the appropriate monetary policy stance, given the economic environment.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Above all, the ESCB strategy must lead to good - that is to say, timely and forward-looking - monetary policy decisions.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: In particular, the strategy must convince the public that the Governing Council is unambiguously committed to maintaining price stability in the euro area and has the resources, information and instruments available to fulfil this commitment.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The more the strategy helps to promote credibility and confidence in the ESCB's monetary policy, the more effective that policy will be - and the easier the ESCB's task of maintaining price stability will become.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Building its reputation, and the associated credibility of monetary policy, is vital.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: However, the transition may also create some special problems for monetary policy makers.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The adoption of the single monetary policy marks a significant regime shift.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The effect of monetary policy on consumption, investment, and wage bargaining - and therefore the whole transmission mechanism of monetary policy to developments in the price level - will be among the important economic relationships likely to be affected in this way.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: One example of this so-called 'Lucas critique' phenomenon is the impact of current, very low rates of inflation on private behaviour.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: For many countries participating in Monetary Union, there is simply no - or only very recent - experience of how the private sector will behave in an environment of sustained and credible low inflation.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: I have already argued that these structural changes will benefit Europe 's citizens - price stability will allow markets to work more efficiently, thereby raising growth, and improving employment prospects.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: All these factors will alter the relationships between economic variables that NCBs have used as a guide to monetary policy decisions in the past.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The ECB Governing Council has selected a monetary policy strategy of its own, to reflect the unique circumstances that it faces at the start of Monetary Union.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The Governing Council has selected a "stability-oriented monetary policy strategy".

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Neither 'pure' intermediate monetary targeting nor 'pure' direct inflation targeting - which were sometimes referred to as the two most prominent candidates prior to the decision - nor a simple combination of both strategies was deemed to fulfil in an optimal way the ESCB's unique needs.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The ESCB's stability-oriented monetary policy strategy rests on two pillars.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: In parallel with the analysis of monetary developments relative to the announced reference value, a broadly-based assessment of the outlook for price developments and the risks to price stability in the euro area will be undertaken.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: In selecting its monetary policy strategy, the foremost criterion used by the Governing Council was the principle of 'effectiveness'.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The best monetary policy strategy for the ESCB is the one which best signals a credible and realistic commitment to, and ensures achievement of, the primary objective of price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: I am aware that for many external commentators, this criterion points unambiguously in the direction of 'direct inflation targeting'.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: If monetary strategies are to be judged according to how well they achieve price stability, defined as a low rate of measured inflation, then advocates of inflation targets argue an optimal strategy would surely target this low inflation rate directly.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: These commentators would place explicit quantitative targets for inflation itself at the centre of the ESCB's monetary policy strategy.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Indeed, here in the United Kingdom, the Bank of England has set the standard for developing and implementing a monetary strategy based on inflation targeting.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Its Inflation Report undoubtedly represents 'state-of-the-art'.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU

frase: The ECB Governing Council's choice of monetary policy strategy was not governed solely by a desire to signal again our intent to maintain price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: This has already been well established - by the Treaty and by the transparent public announcement of our definition of price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Rather than mainly signalling our intent, the ESCB's strategy must constitute a practical guide that ensures monetary policy is effective in achieving the goal we have been set.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: As a practical guide, there are considerable problems with using inflation itself as the direct target for the ESCB's overall strategy.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Because of the well-known lags in the transmission mechanism of monetary policy to the economy in general, and the price level in particular, it is impossible for a central bank to control inflation directly.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Therefore, 'inflation targeting' in practice means 'inflation forecast targeting' where central banks set monetary policy to keep their best forecast of inflation at the target level deemed consistent with price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: But recognition of this need for forecasts in an inflation targeting strategy immediately raises practical difficulties for the ESCB.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: In the uncertain environment likely to exist at the outset of Monetary Union, forecasting inflation will be difficult, not least because of the many conceptual, empirical and practical uncertainties faced by the ESCB at the start of Stage Three.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Forecasting inflation requires thorough knowledge of the properties of the new euro area- wide data series and experience and understanding of the transmission mechanism of monetary policy in the new euro area economy.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: I see a distinct bias in the academic discussion of the comparative advantages of inflation targeting and monetary targeting.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: But proponents of inflation targeting seem to forget that, in the current context, most of these arguments could also be used against inflation targeting.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: While there are many uncertainties about the economic properties of money in the special circumstances facing the ESCB, there are also considerable uncertainties surrounding the properties of inflation forecasts.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Moreover, the ESCB should not be judged on, or held accountable for, the accuracy of its internal forecasts, including its inflation forecasts.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Indeed, since the published inflation forecast would be 'conditional' - that is, it would be based on the assumption of unchanged interest rates - the forecast is unlikely to be very accurate.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: It will not capture the ESCB's policy responses to any incipient inflationary or deflationary pressures.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Rather, its performance in maintaining price stability - the primary objective assigned by the Treaty - should be used by the public to judge the success of the ESCB's policies.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Consequently, publication of a forecast is only important in so far as it helps to achieve price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Against this background, let me make absolutely clear that the stability-oriented strategy selected by the ESCB Governing Council is not inflation targeting.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The definition of price stability I discussed at some length is not an inflation target.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: As long as the ESCB is governed by the existing provisions of the Maastricht Treaty, it will interpret its mandate as maintaining price stability on this published definition.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: This is quite different from an inflation targeting strategy where the target rate of inflation is set on a year-to-year basis with a specific horizon and the centrepiece of the strategy is a published inflation forecast.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: By the same token, the monetary policy strategy selected by the ESCB is not a variant of intermediate monetary targeting either.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Specifically, an intermediate monetary target would only be a meaningful guide to monetary policy if a stable relationship existed between money and prices, and money was controllable in the short run using policy determined interest rates.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: However, since inflation is fundamentally monetary in origin over the longer-term, giving money a prominent role in the strategy is vital.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: It creates a firm 'nominal anchor' for monetary policy and therefore helps to stabilise private inflation expectations at longer horizons.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Assigning a prominent role to money in the overall stability-oriented monetary policy emphasises the responsibility of the ESCB for the monetary impulses to inflation, which a central bank can control more readily than inflation itself.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Monetary policy will not react "mechanistically" to deviations in this sense.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The reference value will be derived in a manner that ensures, as far as possible, that deviations of monetary growth from the value will signal risks to price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: In the first instance, such a deviation will prompt further analysis to identify and interpret the economic disturbance that caused the deviation, and evaluate whether the disturbance requires a policy move to counter risks to price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: To extract the important signals about inflationary or deflationary pressures contained in the monetary data, the relationship between actual monetary growth and the reference value will be regularly and thoroughly analysed by the Governing Council.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The results of this analysis and its impact on monetary policy decisions will be explained to the public.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Through this process, monetary policy decision-making will be made both clearer and more transparent.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Although the monetary data contain information vital to informed monetary policy making, on their own they will not constitute a complete summary of all the information about the economy required to set an appropriate monetary policy and maintain price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Therefore, in parallel with the analysis of monetary developments in relation to the reference value, the Governing Council will undertake a regular, broadly-based assessment of the outlook for price developments and the risks to price stability in the euro area.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: All the indicators will be thoroughly assessed for the signals that they offer about the threats to price stability over the medium-term and the information they contain regarding the appropriate monetary policy response to disturbances to the economy.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: This thorough analysis cannot be subsumed into a meaningful summary statistic or single number to which monetary policy will react in a mechanical way.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The monetary policy response required to maintain price stability over the medium-term will depend upon both the prevailing circumstances and the source of the threat to price stability.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: All in all, the new stability-oriented monetary policy strategy of the ESCB is designed to avoid giving the impression that monetary policy responds "mechanistically" to deviations from a single target or the evolution of a specific variable.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The monetary policy strategy selected by the ESCB signals that monetary policy decisions will focus on maintaining price stability over the medium-term, responding to new developments in the economy in a manner that is consistent with this over-riding objective.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: I am confident that the strategy selected by the Governing Council will be successful and price stability in the euro area will be maintained.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The ESCB will have a complete set of monetary policy instruments at its disposal.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: These instruments have been selected on the basis of their efficiency for transmitting monetary policy and their neutrality across market participants.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Open market operations include, first, a weekly main refinancing operation, which will take the form of a reverse repurchase transaction with a maturity of two weeks.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The main refinancing operation will be based on a tender procedure.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The tender may be a fixed rate tender, with counterparties bidding amounts, or a floating rate tender, where counterparties propose bids including both amounts and interest rates.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Second, there is the monthly longer term refinancing operation, which has a maturity of three months and will always take the form of an interest rate tender.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: This is because the ESCB will avoid signalling its monetary policy stance through these particular operations.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The deposit facility will be remunerated at a rate that will constitute the lower bound of overnight money market rates.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Two main monetary policy objectives have been assigned to the minimum reserve system.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: The first objective is to stabilise money market interest rates through the averaging mechanism, whereby the fulfilment of minimum reserve requirements is based on average reserve holdings over monthly periods of time.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: Reserve holdings will be remunerated up to the required reserve level, at the rate of the main refinancing operation (as averaged over the month).

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: It may be argued that a less than full remuneration of minimum reserves would increase the interest rate elasticity of central bank money demand.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: We are only thirty-six days away from the moment when the responsibility for monetary policy decisions in the euro area is officially transferred to the Governing Council of the ECB.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU
frase: A stability-oriented monetary policy strategy has been selected and the operational framework has been tested and will be in place as of January 1999.

titolo: The European Central Bank on the eve of EMU

frase: I should now like to elaborate a little on the benefits of price stability, before moving on to the role of monetary policy in economic policy.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: I have already highlighted the importance of price stability in shaping a stability-oriented macroeconomic context in the euro area.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: Indeed, the empirical evidence suggests that price developments are more predictable when the inflation rate is low; price stability thus enhances the predictability of the macroeconomic environment.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: A situation of low inflation also allows households and firms to base their economic decisions on more reliable information, as they may find it easier to distinguish movements in relative prices from movements in the general price index.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: Both of these aspects of price stability lead ultimately to a more efficient allocation of resources, which is of vital importance for the economic welfare of society in the long run.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: For instance, firms may engage in long-term investments without fearing that an unexpected surge or decline in the inflation rate could cause their commitment to be sub-optimal or even unsustainable.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: In the same vein, households may plan an optimal allocation of saving and consumption over their lifetime, without facing the risk of the real value of financial assets changing on account of an unexpected rise or decline in the inflation rate.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: As a consequence, real interest rates, i.e.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: A situation of price stability also avoids the risk of borrowers being confronted with a rising real value of financial debts, which are normally fixed in advance in nominal terms, in the event of an unexpected and persistent decline in prices.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: High inflation or persistent deflation is costly for society even in the best possible scenario, i.e.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: For example, at times of high inflation sellers must continuously update menus and households expend needless time and energy when they are forced to economise on liquid balances.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: Finally, I should like to emphasise the fact that price stability is particularly beneficial for the political cohesion of society, because inflation (but also deflation) brings about an undemocratic redistribution of economic resources.

frase: The Treaty therefore provides an explicit order of priority for the objectives: price stability is the first reference point for the monetary policy of the ESCB, and only within the limits of price stability can there be scope to contribute to the achievement of the other objectives of the European Community.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: As a consequence, the role of other Community objectives in the monetary policy of the ESCB is conditional upon the achievement of the overriding target of price stability.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: That said, however, we should realise that what monetary policy is able to contribute to economic policy and the reduction of unemployment, is the achievement of price stability.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: Moreover, in specific circumstances, if production, inflation and employment all move in the same direction, monetary policy can play a role in stabilising output and employment growth, without endangering price stability.

frase: A clear example can be found in the Netherlands, where a substantial reduction in unemployment has been effected in recent years by reforming the labour market, while following the same monetary policy as Germany, where the unemployment rate is still close to 10%.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: In this respect, the medium-term orientation of the monetary policy of the ESCB should help to avoid excessive fluctuations in real economic activity.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: Given the fact that the ESCB does not aim to stabilise every short-term deviation of price developments from the predetermined path of price stability, it contributes to the stabilisation of economic activity around its long-run potential growth path.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: I should like to add, however, that the room for manoeuvre of monetary policy and the degree of success in terms of maintaining price stability crucially depend on the support of sound fiscal policies and responsible wage settlements in the euro area.

frase: I should now like to address the way in which the economic environment and the economic policies of both the Community and the governments of Member States will affect the functioning of monetary policy.

frase: A monetary policy reaction to inflationary pressures and the uprooting of inflationary expectations may cause short-run fluctuations in real output.

titolo: The role of monetary policy in economic policy
frase: Flexible and competitive goods and labour markets, however, would soften this trade-off, thereby allowing central banks to attain the goal of price stability with less serious adverse consequences for real output.

frase: As you are aware, the ECB's monetary policy strategy focuses on the primary objective of price stability, which is defined as a year-on-year increase in the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) for the euro area of below 2%.

frase: In sum, weighing all the relevant indicators and taking a forward-looking and medium-term perspective, the Governing Council considered it appropriate to lower the interest rates on its monetary policy instruments.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: A main consideration underlying this decision was that monetary growth slightly above the reference value is at the moment not seen as a risk to future price stability.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: With its recent decisions, the Eurosystem underscored its commitment to a stability-oriented monetary policy course, which is required for creating economic conditions that enable a full use of the growth potential of the euro area.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: In addition, the significant cut in ECB interest rates should help to reduce uncertainty about future economic developments and thereby restore confidence.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: In particular with a view to continued reduction in unemployment, monetary policy needs to be accompanied by structural measures to improve the functioning of labour and product markets.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: It is my firm belief that the best contribution the ECB can make to support employment and social stability consists in fulfilling its primary objective defined by the Treaty, the maintenance of price stability.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Indeed, the pursuit of a stability-oriented monetary policy yields important social benefits.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Moreover, one must not neglect the fact that households at the lower end of the income spectrum are particularly vulnerable to inflation, since they are likely to suffer the most from a loss of value of their income and savings.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Therefore, price stability and social stability are not conflicting, but supplementary and mutually reinforcing policy objectives.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: As envisaged, the initial narrowing of the interest rate corridor set by the standing facilities was not extended beyond 21 January 1999.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: You won't be surprised to hear that here in the European Parliament, the cut in interest rates was something that we very much welcomed.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Looking at the political situation, you pointed out that what is important is the maintenance of internal price stability; we have to keep the value of the euro stable within the euro-zone.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
parole_chiave: inflationary; interest rate; interest rates; monetary policy
frase: Can I start by welcoming the recent interest rate reduction, but can I ask Mr Duisenberg, given the absence of any inflationary pressure earlier in the year, I put it to Mr Duisenberg that the ECB could have pursued a more aggressive monetary policy of lower interest rates at that time in order to offset the output effect of the negative external shock.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Indications that the inflationary pressures in line with that have come down is a change which was observed by us in many indicators, based also on forecasts and enquiries about the expected rate of inflation.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999

frase: You said recently that you cut the interest rate to support the general economic policies of the Community.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: So you might also say that the weighing of all these risks with regard to both pillars of our monetary strategy means that it is possible for us to pay due attention to the secondary objective of monetary policy of the ECB, namely to support without risk to price stability, the general economic policies in the Community.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Mr Duisenberg, I am very satisfied but also puzzled by the recent interest rate cut.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: I am puzzled even more because of your latest answer to Mr Hendrick, because in the January monthly report there was an extensive section on your monetary policy strategy and in that you explained that the secondary goal of monetary policy, namely the supporting of economic policy of the Member States, was reduced to the mere result of the primary goal, price stability.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Now you have made an interest rate cut apparently to support the economic policy, which I welcome, but now I want to know first if you plan to revise your monetary policy strategy?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Apparently there is a long- standing goal to support the economic policy and second, by what transmission mechanism do you expect this interest rate cut to support the economic policy and with what delays?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: As I fully explained in my introductory statement, they are based on an assessment of the events with regard to the two main pillars, both the money supply developments and the broadly-based assessment of a range of indicators having to do with the outlook for price stability.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: As I believe I explained adequately, changes in these, as I said to Mr Hendrick, clarify and explain the decision to reduce interest rates.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: The question has been asked, not here but elsewhere, has the ECB suddenly changed into an institution which has an activist, cyclically determined monetary policy outlook?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Regarding the second part of the question on the transmission mechanism.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Even a significant interest rate cut of the size we have undertaken, if you put that in the various models that are available across "Euroland" and try to measure the impact on real output and investment, then the impact of a change in short-term interest rates is very limited indeed.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: How it works its way through in the markets might also have an impact on long-term interest rates with some delay.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: That is a matter which could inspire somewhat more confidence in the positive influence that this interest rate move might have.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: But in itself, I am not able to put a figure on what precisely the impact on growth of output and employment and investment and consumption will be of this cut in interest rates, but as for the sign we are pretty sure that it will be a plus.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: It is because you tried to convince us before that real interest rates are so low already that it would not work to cut them and second, that if it would work it would work only in the long-term.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: In addition to that, by implication, I am saying that we are still awaiting the effects of the significant decline in interest rates which has taken place across the euro area in the course of 1998, and particularly in the second half of 1998.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: First I would like to know about the reduction in interest rates.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: If I have understood your arguments on the interest rate and growth, that seems to be quite clear, but I want to know if the ECB could invoke some sort of adapted or modified Taylor Rule?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: I don't know exactly how you would call it but it seems that monetary policy is now based on a strategy on the one hand of inflation targeting, and the gap between potential and real growth on the other.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: It would be too limited to say that our monetary strategy would be based on two indicators only as you suggest, that is inflation and the output gap.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: If you look at aggregates in M1 and M2 you see, particularly in M1, it is above 9%, so that would seem to indicate that we are already in the middle of a very expansionist monetary policy and therefore we could fear in a couple of years a renewal of inflation.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: I think you can look at the other side of the coin and say we have to have a long-term vision and perhaps there actually is a fear of inflation there.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Something we look at in the first place and then make a judgement on the actual figure for the monetary aggregate, the difference between it and the reference value chosen and to what extent we should interpret that as giving rise to fears for inflation or deflation.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: It is then a matter of, admittedly subjective, judgement by all members of the Governing Council whether these figures in themselves would add to the fear that inflation might be on the rise again.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Do you think there are some other reasons behind the decision to reduce the interest rate, apart from weak economic growth?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Could another reason be that you wanted to avoid getting into the same situation as the Bank of Japan where there would be deflationary pressures on the horizon, and this on the basis of the reasons related to your own forecast of growth rates?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: On the contrary, the experience in Japan was almost more of an incentive that we should not fall into that trap, namely of lowering interest rates to a level close to zero, as has been undertaken in Japan, with no noticeable effect on the real economy, so far at least.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: It seems that monetary policy in the Japanese situation does no longer work, does not function, does not do the trick, of helping the economy to revive again.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: That would be more of an argument against further lowering interest rates rather than in favour of it.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: This was perhaps the right time, but also could I ask whether inside the Governing Council there might have been voices raised warning against cuts in interest rates and, if so, could you tell us what arguments were advanced by those who might have held those views?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: I have already mentioned the argument which seemed to argue against a lowering of interest rates, that is the expectation that inflation may, but we think temporarily, increase somewhat.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: That in itself is an argument against the lowering of interest rates, but if you add to that that you expect it to be of a temporary nature only and limited in size, you come to the judgement that it is very unlikely that inflation will even approach the critical figure of 2%.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: But there were counter arguments also and so at the end of the exchange of views of all the arguments, pro and con, led to the consensus that the proposal which I made to the Council to lower interest rates by 50 basis points, was accepted without even taking a vote.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: I have a worry though about the real economy and the effects that this will have subsequently on monetary policy.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Don't you think it's time to start interfering a bit - I know it's beyond your brief, but maybe you should do it - underlining the fact that the structural efforts do not seem to work in Europe, they don't seem to work at all and to avoid or to pre-empt pressure on you subsequently, to change your monetary policy in ways to counteract this in-built recession possibility?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Given what you said - which, if you do not follow the half empty, half full glass, more or less agrees with what I am worried about - should you not prepare to pre-empt the pressure being put on you in order to switch your, successful in my mind, monetary policy into something that temporarily will alleviate things?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: I have added to that that this interest rate removes, at least may I phrase it like this, any alibi that politicians might have thought they had in not taking structural measures.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: In the short run you can control the short-term interest rate, that is granted, but in the short run many demand functions are notoriously unstable, so you cannot, in fact, control them in the short run.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: In the medium-run they are more stable, but in the medium-run you cannot control long-term interest rates.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: So why have these pillars and why not limit yourself from the broadly based assessment of the outlook for future price developments which seems to me to be a lot of words for an inflation target?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Well it is a lot of words, but it explicitly is not an inflation target.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: That we do not have and we do believe that monetary policy with its instruments if not control can at least to a large extent manipulate the movements in money supply in a broad sense.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: This shoud be coupled with the strong belief that ultimately, in the long-run, inflation is a monetary phenomenon and that inflation is in the longer-run determined by the developments in monetary aggregates.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Therefore, it seems to us to be indicative that the development of the money supply should play an important role in the assessment of the absence or presence of inflationary pressures.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Moreover, we said it can influence or manipulate the short-term interest rates to a very high extent.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Really we tried to steer for example the overnight lending rate to close to the repo-rate after the last lowering of interest rates on 8 April, it took us about 4-5 days I think before we had successfully steered that overnight rate to close to the repo- rate, where it has remained ever since.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: How many central banks adopt the control of the supply of money as a means of handling their monetary policy?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Well I don't believe that, but then I would also say that for central banks which explicitly have other targets, for example the Bank of England, which has an inflation target, this does not mean that the Bank of England or its Monetary Policy Committee would not look at developments in the monetary aggregates as well, as one of the indicators that might have some impact on their ultimate target.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: I don't have the full explanation, but one explanation I could point to is that interest rates in "Euroland" are significantly lower than interest rates in the UK, and that's a purely economic argument.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: It also explains of course, in part, the relative strength of the US dollar, vis-à-vis the euro, as interest rates are also significantly higher in the US than in Europe.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: At what stage will confidence in the perceptions of the financial markets reach the point where they will feel that there is not the political will in Europe to bring about these structural changes, and what impact is that going to have in terms of the way in which you view future developments in monetary policy?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: What would be the effect on Europe and on your monetary policy if we see major changes or fluctuations in the US stock market?

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Now if you analyse it on the basis of the two pillars, there would be no reason to lower interest rates, so I entirely agree with you, but having said that I feel you would probably be better advised to explain the complexity of the situation.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Furthermore, according to the press, you said that the recent cuts in interest rates would be the last for a long time.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: I did not say that interest rates will never be lowered again.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Last week, if I might take it as an anecdote, a Member of the British Parliament said to me that he was a close follower of the monthly bulletin, of the transcripts of the press conferences and of the question and answer sessions during the press conferences, on the Internet and that he had come to the conclusion that the transparency and openness of the ECB compares rather favourably with that of the Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of England.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Governor, you said to Mr Metten earlier that you were not quite clear about the transmission mechanisms from this present cut in interest rates to the real economy partly because the database was not yet complete.

frase: Whether it comes to measuring money aggregates or inflation expectations or all the rest, the problem is that there isn't enough information about the way in which the euro-zone economy works as a whole and so in a sense you are flying blind.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: It seems to me that the uncertainty that governs your measurement of monetary policy at the moment allows you to at least to argue that you could take a few risks because no-one knows exactly what is happening.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: All we can with certainty is that inflation risks are very low indeed.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Those countries that have done some of the structural reforms that is widely agreed should be a feature of the whole of euro-zone economy have tended to do those changes at a time when they have had a loosening monetary policy or indeed quite a low exchange rate.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: That has certainly been the experience of the United Kingdom and it does seem to me that there is a trade off here that you could offer a more generous interest rate regime perhaps or a more accommodating monetary stance if you were to get very clear undertakings from member governments that they were going to address structural problems.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Secondly, by no means can one maintain that the monetary policy stance of the ECB is not accommodating already.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: I mean interest rates are at historically low levels both in nominal and in real terms.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Monetary aggregates are growing in excess at least of the reference value we defined - or you might say, you have not defined your reference value well enough, that's another matter - but the growth of monetary aggregates and the prevailing level of interest rates throughout this first period of the euro-area both indicate that the monetary policy stance is accommodative, and since 8 April it has become even more accommodative.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Mr Duisenberg, regarding the remark of Mrs Randzio-Plath about the interest rates in Japan and the risk of weakening or even a deflationary situation, you mentioned the importance of the structural changes.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Now you have lowered the interest rate dramatically you have explained that there is a need for structural changes.

frase: You've made it clear from this rate cut that now the ball is in the court of the Member States not just when it comes to employment policies but also when it comes to structural reforms and some of the questions have been touched upon already.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: Before we get onto that round Governor I would like to repeat the request from the Committee that you give us the inflation forecast, that this be published and made available to the Parliament so that we can look into it in greater detail.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: In this way, we can judge whether this 0%-2% band is too narrow, whether we need a further band or whether we should redefine your concept of price stability.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: I have quoted expectations about inflation forecasts from various institutions and in particular from the European Commission, and many international organizations give inflation forecasts.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: We will never make isolated inflation forecasts.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: What we will make - and we have to - is a comprehensive set of expectations about the behaviour of various economic variables, inflation being one of them.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999
frase: There will also come a moment - it is too early but I personally have no doubt that there will come a moment - when we also like many other institutions will publish our forecasts but I explicitly say forecasts, the multiple, and inflation being one of them, but in such a way that they will never become self-fulfilling prophecies.

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999

titolo: Hearing at the European Parliament's Sub-Committee on Monetary Affairs on 19 April 1999

titolo: Monetary policy-making in Europe

titolo: Monetary policy-making in Europe

titolo: Monetary policy-making in Europe

titolo: Monetary policy-making in Europe

titolo: Monetary policy-making in Europe

titolo: Monetary policy-making in Europe

titolo: Monetary policy-making in Europe

titolo: Monetary policy-making in Europe

frase: Some observers have noted that the favourable performance of the US in the 1990s can be attributable to a very lucky and unique combination of events, which coincided and allowed the US to grow faster than would be regarded as normal without generating inflation.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy
frase: The possibility of a New Economy obviously poses challenges for monetary policy.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy
frase: In addition, a protracted increase in the growth rate of the economy would lead to a rise in equilibrium real interest rates.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy
frase: I would suggest that the monetary policy strategy of the Eurosystem is well placed to deal with these challenges.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy
frase: The 'full-information' approach upon which policy decisions are taken - reflected in the two pillars of the strategy - should help to minimise any risks of inappropriate actions, especially since it is designed in a very flexible way which enables it to react to any indicators regarding the future prospects of price stability, including those which would suggest the arrival of a New Economy.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy
frase: The Eurosystem's monetary policy would no way be an impediment to faster growth, which might emerge as a result of New Economy effects.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy
frase: It can safeguard price stability while allowing the economy to realise its growth potential.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy
frase: When account is taken of this role, there are well-based a-priori grounds for believing that inflation is damaging to long-run economic performance and welfare.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy
frase: While empirical evidence in economics is rarely definitive, the available evidence appears to be robust in showing that low inflation is good for output in the long-run; no study of which I am aware suggests an opposite effect.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy
frase: All in all, the conclusion I derive from all this is that a medium-term monetary policy oriented to price stability is the best contribution that a central bank can make to long-run economic performance.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy
frase: The evidence for this contribution is robust, even when one allows for so- called hysteresis effects and the purported 'costs' of low inflation due to downward nominal rigidities.

titolo: How to promote growth in the euro area: the contribution of monetary policy

titolo: The future of banking supervision and the integration of financial markets
frase: Ensuring effective banking supervision and crisis prevention plays a key role in this respect, and is facing challenges from two major sources: the internationalisation of financial activities and the geographical split between the jurisdiction of monetary policy and banking supervision.

titolo: The future of banking supervision and the integration of financial markets
frase: The monetary policy function now embraces the 11 countries that have adopted the euro, while supervision remains a national responsibility.

titolo: The future of banking supervision and the integration of financial markets
frase: In addition to the single monetary policy and the creation of the single risk-free yield curve, two main reasons explain the rapid integration of the wholesale activities in the euro area - of the market for unsecured interbank deposits in particular.

titolo: The future of banking supervision and the integration of financial markets
frase: As I mentioned, the third stage of Economic and Monetary Union introduced a geographical separation of monetary policy and banking supervision - in addition to the possible functional separation of the two functions that already existed in some countries.

titolo: The future of banking supervision and the integration of financial markets
frase: This is the case because, for the euro area as a whole, banking supervision is now entrusted to institutions that have no independent monetary policy functions (even if they are central banks) and the Eurosystem has neither direct responsibility for supervising banks nor for banking system stability.

titolo: The future of banking supervision and the integration of financial markets

frase: This stems from the fact that the banking industry is the key channel for the transmission of monetary policy, the counterpart of monetary policy operations, and the main provider of payment services, which all relate to the basic central banking tasks.

titolo: The future of banking supervision and the integration of financial markets
frase: Central banks are keen to be sure that supervision is conducted in such a way as to ensure that banking problems do not jeopardise the conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: The future of banking supervision and the integration of financial markets
