titolo: The future of banking supervision and the integration of financial markets
frase: In fact, I am convinced that the only way the supervisory function is able to cope effectively with the increasing integration and to bridge the potential shortcomings arising from the geographical separation of monetary policy and banking supervision, is for the competent authorities to enhance their multilateral co-operation.

titolo: The future of banking supervision and the integration of financial markets
frase: To summarise, the present institutional setting for banking supervision in the euro area can cope with the challenges brought about by the increasingly integrated banking and financial system, as well as the issues raised by the separation of monetary policy and supervisory functions.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: During this time, the introduction of the euro and the subsequent conduct and implementation of the single monetary policy have, in my view, been a remarkable success.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Most importantly, the basis for lasting and credible price stability throughout the euro area has been solidified.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Price stability has, in turn, helped to create an environment where economic activity and employment can flourish.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
parole_chiave: inflationary; monetary policy; price stability; wage
frase: With continued wage moderation, fiscal consolidation and the implementation of long overdue structural reforms to labour and product markets, an extended period of sustainable economic growth is possible - provided that the single monetary policy remains resolutely committed to the maintenance of price stability, taking the necessary prompt action to address inflationary pressures as they emerge.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: My comments will focus on three aspects of monetary policy-making: the institutional design of the central bank; the monetary policy strategy; and the operational framework used to implement policy decisions.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Monetary policy is not omnipotent.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Central banks were often charged with meeting several, potentially conflicting, objectives, some of which were simply unattainable using monetary policy alone.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Today, with the regrettable experience of high and rising inflation in the 1970s in mind, the capabilities and limitations of monetary policy are better - although still not universally - understood.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: A broad consensus now exists that the maintenance of price stability is the appropriate objective of monetary policy.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: This consensus is rooted in the belief that monetary policy makes its best contribution to overall economic welfare by maintaining price stability - and thereby allowing the relative price mechanism to work more efficiently.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: The institutional framework for the single monetary policy described in the Maastricht Treaty reflects this economic consensus.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: It establishes a clear hierarchy of objectives for the single monetary policy, with price stability unambiguously assigned overriding importance.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: The experience of the 1970s and 1980s demonstrated the advantages of central bank independence in the pursuit of price stability.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: A monetary policy subject to short-term political concerns and influences could not adopt the medium-term orientation required to maintain stable prices credibly.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Academic studies of the time consistency problem in monetary policy offered an insight into this issue, while empirical evaluations showing a correlation between central bank independence and greater price stability provided compelling supporting evidence.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: In a democratic society, a high degree of transparency and accountability in monetary policy-making should bolster both the legitimacy of the central bank and public support for its price stability mandate.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: At the same time, transparency and accountability impose an external discipline on policy-makers which can add to the credibility, and thereby the effectiveness, of monetary policy.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: I will return to the important issue of transparency in a moment, when I discuss the ECB's monetary policy strategy.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: With regard to accountability, let me simply highlight that, drawing on the successful experience of several central banks, in October 1998 the Governing Council of the ECB decided to publish a quantitative definition of price stability.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: This definition of price stability as an annual increase in the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) for the euro area of below 2%, provides a clear yardstick against which the public, its elected representatives and agents in the media, can hold the ECB accountable.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Within this institutional framework, how should price stability be maintained?

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: This question is addressed by the ECB's monetary policy strategy.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Prior to the introduction of the euro, several central banks, including the Banque de France, assigned a prominent role to money within their monetary policy strategy.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: At the same time, other euro area central banks emphasised the role of inflation forecasts as the key monetary policy indicator.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Of these, several proceeded to announce direct inflation targets, as became fashionable in the 1990s.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Nevertheless, once the commitment to price stability was affirmed, each of these approaches achieved a large measure of success.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: The convergence of inflation rates to low and stable levels across the euro area in the 1990s was a significant - and, in many quarters, unexpected - achievement.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: In my view, this experience offers a powerful illustration that there are several ways to achieve and maintain price stability.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Those who claim that there is only one acceptable or efficient way to operate monetary policy fly in the face of history and experience.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Certain key elements - for example, affirming a commitment to the objective of price stability; defining this objective clearly; evaluating a broad range of indicators, including monetary aggregates, real and financial variables and macroeconomic forecasts - were, in fact, common to all successful strategies.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Taking note of these two observations, the Governing Council of the ECB adopted a strategy which aimed to maintain some continuity with the strategies pursued by NCBs in the euro area prior to Monetary Union while, at the same time, ensuring that the new and distinct challenges facing monetary policy in a wholly new currency area were appropriately addressed.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: We recognised at the outset that the key feature of a successful strategic framework for monetary policy can be described in very simple terms.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Monetary policy must always be determined in the manner which best serves the maintenance of price stability over the medium term.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
parole_chiave: governing council; monetary policy; price stability
frase: In taking monetary policy decisions with the goal of price stability in mind, the Governing Council relies on the information about the economic situation and the threats to price stability that is revealed by a thorough analysis of a very broad range of economic indicators.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: The first pillar of the strategy, which assigns a prominent role to money, reflects the fundamentally monetary origins of inflation over the medium to longer term.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: The aim of the analysis is to extract information contained in the monetary and credit data that is required by monetary policy-makers to take decisions.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: In consequence, the analysis naturally focuses on the information content of money regarding the outlook for price developments considering both inflationary and deflationary risks.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: In the end, it is this evidence which makes us confident that monetary and credit aggregates are an important indicator for assessing risks to price stability.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: The second pillar of the strategy is associated with a complementary, but more eclectic, approach, which implies that a wide range of indicators is of relevance for monetary policy.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: While inflation is a monetary phenomenon over the medium term, at shorter horizons it will be influenced by many other variables.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Changes in international commodity prices, such as the price of oil, will influence developments in consumer price inflation.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Moreover, policy-makers will generally need to tailor their actions to the prevailing economic circumstances, since the impact of monetary policy on the future evolution of the price level at any specific time will depend on a host of factors which are not captured by monetary data.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Analysis under the second pillar is intended to reveal this information, giving policy-makers greater insight into shorter-run price dynamics and their implications for monetary policy.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Monetary policy-making in the euro area has to reflect the complexities and uncertainties which surround the transmission mechanism of monetary policy in a wholly new economic entity.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: The academic literature and other external commentators are slowly coming to recognise the importance of "robustness" in monetary policy-making - something which I believe has been understood by central bankers for some time.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: A successful monetary policy is not one that performs "optimally" in the context of a specific model or given a particular view of the world.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Rather - given the great uncertainty faced by central banks - a successful monetary policy should perform well in a broad range of possible situations and across a variety of models or views of the world, each one of which may capture important aspects of actual economic behaviour or may, ex post, turn out to be close to reality.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Monetary policy-making is therefore complex.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: In my view, the transparency of the monetary policy process is best understood as the extent to which the external, presentational role of the strategy is consistent with the internal, decision-making procedure.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: As a party to both the decision-making and the presentation of the single monetary policy, I can assure you that the correspondence between the internal and external aspects of the Eurosystem's strategy is extremely close.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Discussions in the Governing Council take into account, on the one hand, an analysis of monetary developments and their implications for monetary policy and, on the other, an assessment of other financial and economic indicators, including macroeconomic projections based on conventional forecasting models and expert judgement.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Drawing together these arguments, let me emphasise that a monetary policy strategy should not be seen as a machine that mechanically delivers policy decisions.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Monetary policy-making cannot be reduced to a reaction to a single figure, be it monetary growth or an inflation projection taken from a model or a group of experts.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Nor can monetary policy be formulated on the basis of a single chart, however colourful.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: This robust approach to monetary policy-making is at the heart of the ECB's strategy.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Before concluding, I should also like to make a few additional remarks on the operational framework used to implement monetary policy decisions in the euro area.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: At the same time, the introduction of the single monetary policy offered an opportunity to design the operational framework afresh, ensuring that best practice was adopted throughout the euro area.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: The resulting framework provides for a broad set of instruments and procedures to implement monetary policy.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: Thus far, this framework has worked very effectively in clearly signalling the stance of monetary policy and containing the volatility of short-term market interest rates.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: At the heart of the framework is the so-called "corridor" for the overnight market interest rate, which is defined by the interest rates on the deposit and marginal lending facilities.

titolo: From the EMI to the ECB
frase: As I have argued today, both the Eurosystem's strategy and its operational framework have exploited this wisdom to the full, while recognising the new and different challenges faced by the single monetary policy in the euro area.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Once more it is my pleasure to appear before your Committee in order to report on the recent monetary policy decisions taken by the ECB and on the reasoning underlying these decisions.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: I should also like to add a few words on the change in the procedures for the allotment of liquidity in the main refinancing operations of the Eurosystem, beginning with the operation to be settled on 28 June 2000.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Over the past few months both pillars of the monetary policy strategy of the Eurosystem have indicated that upward risks to price stability have increased.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Developments in the first pillar thus indicated that upward risks to price stability had increased over the past few months.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Looking at the information provided under the second pillar, the outlook for growth in the euro area has improved further since our last meeting in March, while upward risks to consumer price inflation have continued to increase.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: With regard to consumer price developments, inflation has recently risen above the level expected by most forecasters at the end of last year.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: At the same time, according to currently available forecasts, consumer price inflation will exceed, this year and next year, the levels forecast at the end of last year.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The level and the pattern of overall HICP inflation observed over the past few months largely reflect the impact of oil price developments on the energy component of the HICP.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In March, annual headline inflation was 2.1%.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Overall, for these reasons, HICP inflation is not expected to fall significantly in the near future.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In the context of robust economic growth, these short-term upward pressures were considered to potentially increase the risks of second-round effects, implying that they could have longer-lasting effects on consumer price inflation, if monetary policy did not counteract these in a timely manner.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
parole_chiave: governing council; interest rates; monetary policy; price stability
frase: Therefore, in response to these upward risks to price stability, as they emerged from the analysis under both pillars of the monetary policy of the Eurosystem, the Governing Council of the ECB decided to increase ECB interest rates by 25 basis points on 27 April 2000, and by 50 basis points on 8 June.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The rate on the main refinancing operations has thus reached 4.25%.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The Governing Council also decided on 8 June to switch to a new tender procedure for the allotment of liquidity in the main refinancing operations of the Eurosystem.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The decisions taken by the Governing Council of the ECB reflected the forward-looking character of the monetary policy of the Eurosystem.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: I should like to stress that the decisions of the Eurosystem should be interpreted as responses to risks to price stability in the medium term before they materialise, rather than as reactions to a situation whereby price stability has already been jeopardised.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The answer to this question has important implications for our assessment of the monetary policy stance, as it potentially affects the interpretation of some of the analysis conducted under both pillars of the monetary policy strategy of the Eurosystem.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: This reference value is compiled from the estimated trend growth of real GDP, the estimated trend decline in the velocity of circulation of M3 and the quantitative definition of price stability.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In the light of the prospects for strong economic growth and upside risks to price stability which I have already mentioned, the question has been raised as to whether these developments would require a revision of the reference value for monetary growth.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We will take our findings into account when reviewing the reference value and taking monetary policy decisions.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The challenge to turn the current expansion into a prolonged period of non-inflationary growth clearly requires further efforts in all policy areas.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Reforms in the labour market will be a major factor contributing to sustained non-inflationary growth in the euro area.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In this respect, both appropriate wage settlements and structural reforms will be important contributions to continued employment growth and to maintaining low inflation.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Let me now turn to the decision of the Governing Council to modify the procedure for the allotment of liquidity in the main refinancing operations of the Eurosystem.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: As a matter of fact, since early 2000, the bids submitted in the main refinancing operations of the Eurosystem have been following a steady upward trend, leading ultimately to allotment ratios of less than 1% of the bids.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: For this reason, we decided that the main refinancing operations would be conducted as variable rate tenders using the multiple rate auction procedure, beginning with the operation to be conducted in one week from now.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Contrary to the fixed rate tender procedure, whereby the counterparties of the Eurosystem submit bids for a specified amount of liquidity, the new procedure implies that the counterparties will also indicate in their bids the interest rate they are prepared to pay for the requested amount of liquidity.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: This should eliminate the incentive to overbid, for in the new format of the auction the bidding behaviour of counterparties should be constrained by interest rate cost considerations.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: I should like to stress that the switch to variable rate tenders is in no way intended to further modify the stance of the monetary policy of the Eurosystem.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In order to underline this intention, and to be able to continue to send a clear signal concerning the monetary policy stance, we decided to introduce a minimum bid rate, below which no valid bid may be submitted.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: This rate will signal the monetary policy stance of the Eurosystem, and thereby assume the role that has, so far, been performed by the main refinancing rate in the fixed rate tender procedure.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: President, first of all I would like to point out that with the most recent interest rate decisions you have departed from your preceding practice.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Instead of taking very small steps to increase interest rates, you have taken a decision for 50 basis points, and that's a very clear signal.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: First of all, you followed an interest rate policy which strongly departs from the policy of the US which I think has helped the development of the exchange rate.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: With the interest rate, there was a fairly big difference in interest rates and that has encouraged investors to invest in the US rather than in Europe because of this interest rate differential.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: But now you have sent out a clear message on stability, because the inflation rate has reached 2.0% whereas in the US there is tranquillity about the fact that now the inflation rate is fixed above 3.0%.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In Europe, monetary policy has to support the resumption of sustained, long-term economic growth from a period where economic performance has been sub-optimal in 1998 and first half of 1999, to mention only the most recent period.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: I want to point out in the first place that the level of interest rates about which we talk in Europe is still significantly lower than it is in the US.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: First of all, there are signs that the risks to inflation are becoming stronger all the time and they have been confirmed by the release of the latest figures in the course of May.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: One additional advantage, I certainly will not deny that, even though it was not our aim, one additional advantage is that it does seem to have somewhat diminished the significant interest rate differential which existed between the two large economic areas (the United States and the euro area), which is a welcome development.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The fact that you have put up interest rates now could in the medium-term signify that we'll actually have to renounce a certain amount of growth, because that will have a braking effect on our economy.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In the United States, the inflation rate of more than 3% seems to be permitted whereas you decided to act.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Now, leaving aside the institutional question and the fixing of interest rates just decided by the ECB, I would like to know what the disadvantage of a strategy would be which, regarding the inflation rate, would be more lax as regards the inflation rate than the strategy you are following?

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We are convinced that raising interest rates to the level that we have done, now the main interest rates are at 4 1/4%, in no way will frustrate the prospects for robust economic growth over the 2 years to come.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: I want to point out that, without associating myself entirely with it, that the OECD for example has forecast that growth in the euro area will be well in excess of 3% both in 2000 and 2001, but they also say that interest rates will have to rise to the 5% level in that same period.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Now, without associating myself with that, it demonstrates that sustained growth is possible and even likely with interest rates significantly higher than they are at present.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: I also want to point to the American experience, where we have seen a period of prolonged economic growth, it seems clearly above the long term potential of the American economy, with interest rates 100, 200, sometimes 300, basis points higher than prevailing in Europe.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: What would be the advantage or what would be the disadvantage that you would see were we to allow a higher inflation rate as is now the case in the United States?

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Our main mandate is to preserve price stability.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Now what is price stability?

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Price stability will be preserved if the annual rate of HICP inflation is below the limit of 2%, thereby reckoning that the measurement bias which may be included in the price measurement will not exceed 2%.

titolo: Hearing before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: And so we are satisfied as long as future inflation remains below 2%, and we are convinced at the moment and with this monetary policy stance that ceteribus paribus we are fulfilling that condition, that the monetary policy stance which we have now chosen is appropriate for that outcome.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: Another trend is the solid establishment of price stability in the euro area.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: During the second half of the 1990s, the rate of increase in consumer prices at the level of the euro area declined steadily to reach values in line with price stability.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: Even more importantly, during this period the citizens, firms and other organisations of the euro area progressively came to consider it credible that price stability would henceforth continue to be firmly maintained.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: This confidence on the part of the public is of the utmost importance for the continued success of the monetary policy of the Eurosystem.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: As we all know, price stability is beneficial in numerous ways, not only in creating a climate for higher economic activity over the medium term, but also in reducing the economic and social inequalities caused by the asymmetric distribution of the costs of inflation on the various economic agents.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: In addition, when inflation is low and expected to remain low and subject to limited variations over the medium term, the prices of financial assets incorporate lower inflation risk premia, by contrast with a situation of high or uncertain inflation.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: As the inflation risk premium becomes relatively less important as a determinant of financial prices, other factors such as credit risk can take on a larger role in the price formation mechanism.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: From the point of view of monetary policy, let me recall that the internationalisation of the euro is not a policy objective as such and that, therefore, it will be neither fostered nor hindered by the Eurosystem.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: Furthermore, as I mentioned earlier, financial prices generally incorporate much lower inflation risk premia.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: As a result of lower foreign exchange and inflation risk premia, credit risk has gained more importance, in relative terms, in the pricing of financial instruments.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: In the euro area the dispersion of interest rates on loans for house purchase declined noticeably in the course of 1999, continuing a trend which had been apparent since 1996.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: Between 1996 and 1998, the convergence of interest rates on loans for house purchase had been in parallel with the convergence of market interest rates across those countries which would later form the euro area.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: By 1999 differentials between market interest rates had reached stable levels across the euro area.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: However, cross-country differentials between interest rates on loans for house purchase continued to narrow sizeably.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: More specifically, in countries where they used to be particularly high, interest rates on loans for house purchase came closer to the euro area average in 1999.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: This development was particularly interesting as interest rates rose during 1999 from the exceptionally low levels recorded at the beginning of that year.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: In foreign exchange, interest rate and equity markets, bid-ask spreads often declined in 1999 compared with 1998, sometimes very significantly.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: In the context of the conduct of monetary policy, the creation of an area-wide operational framework for the refinancing operations of the Eurosystem has modified the micro-structure of the money market considerably.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: In other segments of the euro-denominated interest rate markets and in the equity market, the range of financial instruments available to market participants expanded markedly in 1999.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: For example, the most widely traded short-term interest rate futures denominated in euro are contracts indexed on the three-month EURIBOR.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area

frase: All in all, there are two main conditions to be fulfilled by instruments to serve as a reference in interest rate derivatives contracts.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area
frase: Meanwhile, the electronification of markets has also made progress in interest rate and equity markets.

titolo: The development of financial markets in the euro area

frase: The ECB has a natural interest in being informed about fiscal and structural policy measures taken in the euro area as these may also influence price developments and the transmission mechanism of monetary policy.

titolo: Current fiscal and monetary policy issues in the euro area
frase: All this exchange of information should not, however, be seen as a form of ex ante co-ordination of monetary policy with other policies.

titolo: Current fiscal and monetary policy issues in the euro area
frase: In fact, ex ante co-ordination of fiscal and monetary policy would risk distracting national governments from carrying out their own responsibilities.

titolo: Current fiscal and monetary policy issues in the euro area
frase: Moreover, political pressures on monetary policy to facilitate or "reward" developments on the fiscal and structural side would raise uncertainty about the objectives of monetary policy, thereby endangering credibility and reducing the benefits associated with the maintenance of price stability.

titolo: Current fiscal and monetary policy issues in the euro area
frase: At the same time, such reforms make it easier for the ECB to maintain price stability.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In your letter of 15 November 2001, you asked me to elaborate further on the ECB's definition of price stability.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In particular, you invited me to express my views on whether a point inflation target, with symmetrical margins, would be more effective, providing a more precise tool for evaluating the ECB's performance.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: I gather from your letter that you see this issue as being closely related to the adoption of an "inflation targeting framework", which is followed by a number of central banks around the world, and you ask me to elaborate on the pros and cons of such approach.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In answering your questions, I would like to separate three issues which are - to my mind - conceptually distinct: the first is the difference between a definition of price stability and an inflation target; the second is whether the final objective of monetary policy should be specified in the form of a point or a range; and the third concerns the framework which is adopted by a central bank in order to pursue its objective.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Starting with the first issue, the difference between a quantitative definition of price stability and an inflation target is that the latter does not necessarily define "price stability", but quantifies the objective with respect to price developments that monetary policy is aiming for.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In fact, historically, there have been many instances when inflation targets were set at levels significantly away from "price stability", often in cases where countries starting from high levels of inflation set a path of inflation targets over time in order to bring inflation down to lower levels.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Therefore, there is a conceptual difference between the ECB's definition of price stability and an inflation target.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Similarities exist only when such inflation targets are aimed explicitly at achieving "price stability".

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: With regard to the second issue, whether a point target or a range would best serve the purpose of quantifying the primary objective, this is indeed an issue which is debated even among proponents of the inflation targeting framework and with regard to which actual practices also vary among central banks following that approach.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: The ECB's quantitative definition of price stability has established a range of inflation outcomes deemed compatible with price stability.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Our view is that a range definition honestly reflects the degree of uncertainty attached to the meaning and measurement of the concept of price stability.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In particular, it allows uncertainty about and possible variations in the measurement bias in the HICP to be accommodated within the range, while ensuring - in all likelihood - that "true" price stability (zero inflation) is included in the range.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Moreover, a range provides a "buffer" in the face of economic shocks and avoids the impression that monetary policy is equipped to (or might attempt to) fine-tune price developments with a high degree of precision.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In this respect, in order to form an appropriate assessment of the success or failure of the ECB's monetary policy, the medium-term orientation of our policy should be borne in mind.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: This acknowledges, inter alia, the existence of short-term volatility in prices, resulting from non-monetary shocks to the price level that cannot be controlled by monetary policy.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Nevertheless, when evaluated over a sufficiently extended period, it is clear that our policy can be considered successful only if price stability, according to our definition, has prevailed for most of the time and if variability of inflation has remained low.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Moreover, as I had already mentioned in my previous letter of 16 October 2001, our definition has served very well the purpose of anchoring medium-term inflation expectations (as evident from inflation expectations derived from market surveys or from the analysis of yields on long-term bonds), also in the face of substantial shocks to the price level over the past three years.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: It has thus reduced inflation uncertainty, thereby lowering the risk premia included in long-term interest rates.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: There is yet another aspect of importance: a range definition helps avoid the impression that monetary policy should feed back mechanically from deviations of HICP inflation or a forecast of future HICP inflation at some fixed horizon from the particular "target point".

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: This is an area where some differences exist between our approach and the approach which is often portrayed as characteristic of an "inflation targeting framework".

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In this regard, let me first say that there is no widely agreed definition of a policy of inflation targeting.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: One rather broad characterisation of an inflation targeting strategy is the prescription that monetary authorities should pursue a credible policy of low and stable inflation.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: This prescription is simple and convincing: monetary policy should pursue an overriding goal of price stability.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Moreover, because of the lags in monetary transmission, monetary policy must be forward-looking.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: If this broad definition were adopted, virtually all stability-oriented central banks would be classified as wedded to an inflation targeting policy framework.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In this broad version, it is fair to say that the inflation targeting line of reasoning has made - together with other pre-existing traditions in monetary policy-making - an important contribution to the diffusion among central banks of a culture of stability.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Inflation targeting is generally also viewed as a strategy that places emphasis on the production and discussion of inflation forecasts within central banks.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: However, in a finer degree of detail and at a more operative level of policy design, inflation targeting is often seen as a framework that makes macroeconomic forecasts the main, or even unique and all-encompassing, tool of the policy-making process and the external communication of policy decisions.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In fact, some observers understand inflation targeting to imply a simple policy rule whereby changes in interest rates should feedback from the deviation between a conditional inflation forecast (normally based on interest rates remaining unchanged at their pre-decision level) and the inflation objective at a specific time horizon (typically two years).

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: First, inflation forecasts, while useful ingredients of monetary policy strategies, do not represent sufficient statistics for the state of the economy at any horizon: the same inflation forecast figure can be associated with quite different states of the world, commanding quite different reactions on the part of the central bank.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: For this reason, the appropriate monetary policy to maintain price stability should always be made conditional on the circumstances and the nature and magnitude of the threat to price stability (for example, on whether the shock is temporary or permanent, on whether it has emerged on the supply or demand side, on whether it is of domestic or external origin).

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In fact, a policy of mechanical feedback from inflation forecasts may introduce unnecessary volatility in output and realised inflation.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In our view, in response to certain shocks, a gradualist and measured monetary policy response aimed at price stability over the medium term is more appropriate than a response to an inflation forecast at a fixed horizon.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Monetary policy needs to focus on the period covering the whole transmission process, bearing in mind that this may span an uncertain and protracted period of time.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Third, as we have already stressed on a number of occasions, inflation forecasts themselves may be subject to a number of problems.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Inflation forecasts (especially at horizons as long as two years) are surrounded by considerable uncertainty.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: The simple characterisation of inflation targeting does not offer guidance to policy-makers as to how to treat this uncertainty.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In the euro area context, however, all evidence tells us that money should be an essential piece of information in the context of a forward-looking monetary policy.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: I should also note that proponents and practitioners of inflation targeting have increasingly recognised some of the problems associated with such simple, text-book versions of inflation targeting prescriptions.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Furthermore, in practice, most inflation targeting central banks have relaxed the definition of the horizon for inflation targeting and have acknowledged that the feed-back from inflation forecasts cannot be mechanistic.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: The ECB's strategy has honestly addressed the problems related to too simple a version of the inflation targeting approach and its two-pillar framework for monetary policy is a balanced response to many of them.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: This approach helps the Governing Council to take robust decisions in assessing the importance of the various indicators and identifying the nature of the treat to price stability.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In particular, we deem it important, within our framework, to clearly separate the production of forecasts, as carried out under the responsibility of the staff, from the monetary policy decisions taken under the responsibility of the Governing Council.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: In addition, in recognition of the fundamentally monetary origins of inflation and reflecting the close relationship between the stock of money and the price level in the euro area over the medium term, our strategy assigns a prominent role to money in the formulation of monetary policy.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: The analysis of monetary developments represents a crucial element for our evaluation of the risks to price stability in the euro area.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Finally, in line with a medium-term orientation in the conduct of monetary policy, we have explicitly avoided a focus on a fixed point horizon.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Rather, when deciding on the appropriate response to potential threats to price stability, we evaluate the effects of both the economic disturbances and our policy action over the whole transmission process.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: The aforementioned elements are reflected in our approach to the presentation of monetary policy decisions to the public.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: Let me conclude by saying that differences in the practices of central banks oriented to price stability are in fact relatively limited.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: We share a number of key elements that guide the conduct of our monetary policy with many central banks labelled followers of the inflation targeting approach, namely a clear, quantitative definition of the overriding objective, a forward-looking orientation of our policy, the awareness of the need to take a broad range of information into account and to communicate with the public in a clear and transparent manner.

titolo: The ECB's monetary policy strategy and the quantitative definition of price stability
frase: As the experience of major central banks in the world has shown, there is no unique way for a successful conduct of monetary policy.

frase: Let me elaborate on certain key elements of the ECB’s strategy, which are critical in reaching robust and sound decisions on the appropriate policy stance consistent with our mandate.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

frase: For instance, monetary policy cannot offset the short-term impact on the price level of an unanticipated rise in commodity prices or indirect taxes.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

frase: There are, however, a number of reasons suggesting that great caution should be exercised in giving such rules an important role in the actual conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion
frase: Indicators that are crucial for the application of these rules – in particular the output gap and the equilibrium real interest rate – are not observable and can only be estimated with a high degree of uncertainty.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion
frase: However, they may be seen as providing a theoretical basis for “inflation targeting”, a framework for monetary policy decision-making, which in various forms has been adopted and pursued quite successfully by a number of central banks.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion
frase: There are different views on how inflation targeting should be defined.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion
frase: In its broadest definition, inflation targeting is simply a monetary policy framework that accords overriding importance to low and stable inflation or price stability.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion
frase: In this sense, almost all central banks that strive for price stability can be described as “inflation targeters”, including the ECB.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion
frase: In a narrower sense, however, inflation targeting is sometimes defined as a framework in which forecasts of future inflation play the central role and are used as the overriding or even sole, all-encompassing tool for internal decision-making and the external communication of policy decisions.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion
frase: At the extreme, inflation targeting is sometimes viewed as an approach that effectively boils down to a simple policy rule, whereby changes in official interest rates are, more or less, mechanically determined as a function of the deviation of an inflation forecast from the inflation objective at a specific fixed time horizon, typically of around two years.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion
frase: In my view, such an exclusive, narrow focus on an inflation forecast would neither do justice to the intrinsic complexity of the decision-making process, nor would it provide a transparent means of communicating this complexity.

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Policy-making in EMU: strategies, rules and discretion

titolo: Lecture on “Activism and alertness in monetary policy”
frase: My definition of activism in monetary policy is, I believe, conventional: activism is the strategic attitude of a central bank that is constantly endeavouring to be faithful to its objective.

titolo: Lecture on “Activism and alertness in monetary policy”
frase: In the case of the ECB, it is the constant striving to keep inflation close to its arithmetic objective, and to take all the steps needed to check nascent inflationary pressures while at the same time trying to minimise unnecessary macroeconomic disruptions in the process.

titolo: Three Questions on Monetary Tightening

titolo: Three Questions on Monetary Tightening
frase: The second problem, which has not been sufficiently debated in the literature but is, in my opinion, quite important is that providing forward guidance to markets, at least to the extent to which it is intended to steer longer-term interest rates, may be difficult and costly to implement.

titolo: Three Questions on Monetary Tightening
frase: Forward guidance is effective if it is credible, and in order to be credible, the central bank has to deliver on past promises.

titolo: Three Questions on Monetary Tightening

titolo: Three Questions on Monetary Tightening
frase: Third, and related to my previous point, a successful forward guidance may pre-empt private sector expectations, reducing their information content.

titolo: Three Questions on Monetary Tightening
frase: Finally, the need of agreeing on a full path of future interest rates, and eventually updating it in light of economic developments, might not be that easy, especially in a complex setting such as the Eurosystem where the Governing Council is composed of eighteen (soon nineteen) members.

titolo: Three Questions on Monetary Tightening
frase: This consideration is especially important in a tightening cycle, when – as I mentioned earlier – monetary policy decisions are subject to criticism and political resistance.

frase: I shall begin by assessing what can be considered the most natural goal of any monetary union: the adoption of a credible monetary policy.

titolo: Europe's Monetary Union in practice
frase: In this context, credibility should be understood as the confidence that economic agents have in the central bank to react to the various shocks affecting the economy in such a way as to be able to ensure price stability.

titolo: Europe's Monetary Union in practice
frase: Accordingly, the first two features of our monetary policy strategy in the euro area are the fact that the ECB and the national central banks (NCBs) of the Eurosystem are fully independent, and the fact that a quantitative definition of the ECB’s primary objective – price stability – has been clearly specified.

frase: Eight years on, however, I think we can safely say that the evidence confirms that the ECB’s monetary policy has been a great success in terms of keeping inflation under control and anchoring inflation expectations at a level in line with our quantitative definition of price stability.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: In my presentation, I would like to address three challenges for monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: They have in common that they derive from ongoing changes in the structure and functioning of the economy that have bearing on the conduct of monetary policy and the transmission of its effects, notably: the process of globalisation; technological advances and changes in productivity growth; and financial innovation and development.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: I will first address these three processes and their consequences for the inflation process.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: Afterwards, I will discuss their common implications for the conduct of the ECB’s monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: Today, I will concentrate on its effects on inflation, which are both direct and indirect.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility

frase: They also reflect, however, the favourable effects on inflation expectations resulting from a credible monetary policy, the reduced bargaining power of labour unions due to changes in workers’ preferences and a larger share of part-time and short-term labour contracts, and the refocusing of bargaining on non-wage elements, such as working hours and benefits.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: One conclusion that has some empirical support is that domestic inflation is no longer determined predominantly by domestic demand and supply constraints, but seems to depend more on the degree of global economic slack.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: Against the background of all these uncertainties, it is even more difficult to predict the impact of globalisation on inflation in the future.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: The favourable influence of globalisation on inflation can be expected to continue in the future as a result of its direct effects on the prices of imported manufactured goods from low-cost countries and, more importantly, as a consequence of its indirect effects on wages and productivity, reflecting the increased competition in labour and product markets.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: At the same time, this disinflationary impact of globalisation may be partly offset – or more than offset – by global inflationary pressures in energy and commodity markets.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: The available evidence for the euro area as a whole suggests that the overall effect of globalisation on inflation has been very modest, or almost negligible, in recent years, although global factors have been a main source to short-term inflation volatility.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: Of course, long-term inflation will ultimately be determined by monetary policy in line with the ECB’s price stability objective.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: Nevertheless, the dynamics of inflation, especially over the short to medium term, are likely to be more influenced by global factors and to be surrounded by greater uncertainty than in the past.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: Productivity growth is an important determinant of aggregate output and inflation dynamics, and has significant implications for the conduct of monetary policy.

frase: The three processes I have examined – globalisation, productivity developments, and financial innovation – pose challenges for monetary policy for two interrelated reasons.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: First, they influence the functioning and dynamics of the economy in ways that may affect the assessment of the outlook for, and the risks to, price stability as well as the transmission of the effects of monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: What are the implications of all this for the formulation and implementation of monetary policy?

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: There are several conclusions pertaining to the assessment of the risks to price stability, the overall monetary policy strategy, and the actual conduct of policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: Let me elaborate on these issues with particular reference to the ECB’s monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: A first conclusion that emerges from the ongoing changes in the real economy and the financial system is that we must deepen our analysis and sharpen our statistical tools so as to better understand these phenomena, improve the measurement of their development and impact in real time, and thus enhance our assessment of their implications for the risks to price stability.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: In other words, they affect the workings of the real economy which is at the centre of the economic analysis of the inflationary process.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: The ECB’s monetary policy strategy which relies on both economic and monetary analysis allows us to use all available information in order to extract, in a comprehensive manner, signals concerning the risks to price stability that are as meaningful as possible.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: This cross-checking, which may also lead to an averaging out of possibly “noisy” signals or persistent prediction errors that may be associated with a particular analytic approach, contributes to a more robust assessment of the evidence available and the risks to price stability.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: Our experience has shown that the ECB’s strategy has proven effective because it has employed all available information to reach a comprehensive assessment of the medium to long-term economic outlook and inflation risks.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: This has been essential for taking decisions on the appropriate monetary policy stance.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: However, the effectiveness of the ECB’s monetary policy also depends on other features of its strategy and its conduct.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: Let me therefore now turn to two elements which characterise the ECB’s monetary policy: commitment and credibility.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: The ability of any central bank to maintain inflation expectations well anchored depends crucially on these two notions which concern the central bank’s intentions and the perception of these intentions by the markets and the public.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: For monetary policy to be effective, especially in a world of changing economic structures and heightened uncertainty, it is essential that the central bank has a well-defined objective and that it expresses clearly and unambiguously its commitment to do everything that is needed to achieve that objective.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: For this success, it was instrumental that the ECB decided early on to adopt and announce a quantitative definition of price stability, namely to keep HICP inflation below but close to 2% over the medium term, as a clear yardstick which serves two purposes.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: On one hand, it clarifies and quantifies the notion of price stability, as mentioned in the Maastricht Treaty, which, therefore, represents the benchmark to assess our performance over the medium term.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: On the other hand, the quantitative definition of the price stability objective guides and helps to anchor private sector expectations of future inflation rates to a clearly defined objective.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: The commitment to pursue a publicly announced explicit price stability objective is important for a successful monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: This requires the central bank to respond in a timely and determined manner to shocks to price stability, and to effectively communicate its policy actions, so that markets and the public understand the rationale behind these actions and their consistency with the objectives and the strategy adopted.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: An undesirable, and possibly substantial, decoupling of inflation expectations from the central bank’s objective can occur if the policy response to inflation is not sufficiently determined – or is perceived not to be.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: If inflation expectations were to become “unanchored”, a much tighter monetary policy would have to be pursued to secure price stability, and high inflation is likely to be accompanied by an economic slowdown or recession.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: These arguments are supported by analysis concerning the optimal conduct of monetary policy under uncertainty and imperfect knowledge.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: Increased uncertainty about the economy’s structure and functioning and its response to a change in monetary policy may have another implication for its conduct.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: This conclusion seems to imply that structural uncertainty and imperfect knowledge about the effects of monetary policy may pose a trade-off between a cautious, gradualist response to shocks, and the need for timely and determined action.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: But under most circumstances, prudence, timeliness and determination are not likely to be conflicting, but rather complementary, attributes of an effective monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy in a Changing World: Commitment, Strategy and Credibility
frase: The commitment to an explicit price stability objective, the adoption of a well-defined strategy, and the credible conduct of policy in line with this commitment should enhance its effectiveness: it calls for determined and prompt action, though without unwarranted activism in responding to shocks and noisy signals.

frase: What does the available evidence tell us about the effectiveness and credibility of the ECB’s monetary policy?

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy
frase: First, I will very briefly address to what extent the monetary policy transmission mechanisms have been affected by globalisation.

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy
frase: The transmission mechanisms are the channels through which monetary policy decisions affect the economy.

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy
frase: Probably, the best-known of them is the interest rate channel.

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy
frase: While the monetary policy instrument is a very short-term interest rate, savings and investment decisions are more influenced by long-term rates.

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy
frase: For instance, while the ECB has hiked its policy rate by 175 basis points since December 2005, the yield on the five-year German bonds has increased by around 80 basis points only, with the yield on the ten-year bond increasing by just around 50 basis points.

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy
frase: To the extent that the link between policy rates and longer-term rates has loosened, it could at first sight be argued that central banks may have a harder time trying to preserve price stability in a global environment.

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy
frase: However, we should recall that, according to the “expectation hypothesis of the term structure”, long term interest rates are also linked to the policy instrument through the expectations of market participants, and that these expectations are to a considerable extent shaped by the monetary policy framework.

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy
frase: Thus, by committing to a transparent and credible monetary policy strategy and consistently implementing it (while also openly communicating the assessment underlying its decisions), a central bank can provide guidance to market participants on how future policy rates are likely to respond to economic developments, while also anchoring inflation expectation.

frase: In doing so, it can retain substantial leverage on long term interest rates.

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy
frase: Overall, an analysis of the transmission channels does not suggest to me that, in a global environment, central banks cannot honour their commitment to price stability.

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy
frase: What seems to be true is that our job as central bankers has become even more demanding, because monetary policy needs to be conducted at a time when the relative importance of various transmission channels may be changing.

titolo: Globalisation and monetary policy

frase: But welfare analysis has also drawn attention to other, and perhaps even more fundamental, channels through which price stability can enhance growth prospects and contribute to the living standards of citizens.

frase: Price pressures in a specific market can signal profitable investment opportunities to firms.

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank
frase: Second, price stability contributes to lower levels of both nominal and real interest rates.

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank
frase: Inflation erodes the real value of nominal claims and, in an inflationary environment, lenders typically require an inflation risk premium to compensate them for the inflation risks associated with their investments.

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank
frase: Third, it is well known that inflation acts like a tax on holdings of cash.

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank
frase: Inflation increases the price of the transaction services of money.

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank
frase: While this certainly is not a palpable economic phenomenon in the euro area today, a handful of hyperinflation episodes in economic history still makes this so-called ‘inflation tax’ one of the most widely known examples of the undesirable consequences of inflation.

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank
frase: By setting the ‘inflation tax’ to negligible levels, price stability minimises transaction costs in the economy as a whole.

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank
frase: In this respect, pensioners who have to live on their pension entitlements and savings accumulated during their working life constitute a group that is particularly vulnerable to inflation.

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank
frase: This is why a credible commitment to maintaining price stability is so important for the living standards of European citizens.

titolo: Hearing of Jean-Claude Trichet, President of the European Central Bank
