frase: These advances have allowed monetary policy to be based on a set of “scientific principles and to rely more on concrete econometric models – of increasing sophistication and policy relevance – when making decisions on the appropriate monetary policy stance.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: And I fully share the view about the need to continue pursuing research and analysis that can provide a stronger scientific basis for monetary policy, while, of course, recognising that monetary policy-making will never be transformed into a routine process of mechanical application of principles and rules.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Nevertheless, there are several issues I would like to elaborate further pertaining to (i) the role and importance of the core scientific principles that should guide monetary policy; (ii) the current state and limitations of the scientific aspects of monetary policy-making; and (iii) the orientation of our future efforts towards enhancing the science and effectiveness of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: In order to assess whether and to which degree monetary policy can be characterised as a science or has features of a science, it is useful to keep in mind that the two concepts “science” and “policy” are rather distinct and to explain what precisely we mean when we ask whether monetary policy will become more of a science.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: The subject we have in mind is not monetary economics, but monetary policy, that is a course of action adopted by an authority to achieve certain objectives.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: To this end, it is necessary to define monetary policy in greater detail.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: In trying to identify the “systematic knowledge” and “core principles” of monetary policy, and how these in turn derive from theoretical propositions and are supported by the empirical evidence, I find it useful to think of monetary policy as comprising three essential components: the institutional setting the policy framework, which includes the policy objective and the analytical foundations – theoretical and empirical – linking objectives and instruments the communication and the actual conduct of policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Monetary policy has become more of a science over the past fifty years because all its main components are now based on core principles derived from theoretical propositions or arguments that have been scrutinised and tested, to different degrees, on the basis of the available empirical evidence, that is by observing reality: the practice and performance of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Let me elaborate on the nine principles presented by Mishkin also in relation to the ECB’s monetary policy framework.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: The first three principles that (i) inflation is fundamentally a monetary phenomenon, (ii) that price stability has important welfare benefits, including its contribution to sustained growth and reduced output volatility, and (iii) that there is no long-term trade-off between unemployment and inflation are widely accepted and clearly underpin and are reflected in the ECB’s mandate and primary policy objective.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: These first three principles and the eighth principle about the importance of central bank commitment to a nominal anchor imply that price stability (or an inflation target) should be the primary, overriding objective of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
parole_chiave: inflation; monetary policy; transmission of monetary policy
frase: The fourth principle concerning the crucial role of expectations in the determination of inflation dynamics and in the transmission of monetary policy is also universally recognised and constitutes one of the key advances in the analytical foundations of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
parole_chiave: inflation; monetary policy; price stability; transmission mechanism
frase: The role of inflation expectations as a main channel of the monetary policy transmission mechanism motivates the focus placed by central banks on the analysis and use of several indicators of inflation expectations and explains the importance attached in the anchoring of expectations to price stability also in the ECB’s communication policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: This is an area, however, where more progress is necessary, as I will discuss later on, in order to better measure, model and favourably influence the inflation expectations of the public at large.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Two other principles, (i) the importance of central bank independence in order to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of monetary policy and (ii) the need to ensure consistent implementation of monetary policy over time, are reflected in the institutional set-up of most central banks, including the ECB.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Political authorities, however, occasionally seem to ignore or forget the significance of central bank independence, which they themselves enshrined in the EU Treaty, precisely on the basis of past experience and the worldwide evidence which clearly demonstrate its contribution to effective decision-making that preserves price stability and helps minimise output volatility.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Central bank independence is also crucial for ensuring that another principle – the commitment to a strong nominal anchor – is credible and thus effective in ensuring price stability.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: For the ECB, the unambiguous commitment to price stability is reflected in the quantification of its policy objective and its communication, but most importantly in its determination and consistency in pursuing price stability (the nominal anchor).

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: So far, I have fully agreed with the role and significance of seven, out of the nine, principles proposed by Frederic for providing the scientific underpinning of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: There are two principles, however, that I do not consider as having been fully and widely accepted and reflected in the practice of monetary policy: the principle concerning the role and usefulness of monetary policy rules and the one pertaining to the role of financial frictions in business cycles.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: In the case of the policy rules, the simple reason is that they are not used – by most central banks – in the actual conduct of monetary policy, although they may be used for analytical purposes and as benchmarks for comparison of the policies implemented in practice.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: There are several reasons why such rules are not used in the practice of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: One such reason, which I will highlight later on, is related to the imperfect inflation available for estimating reliably key variables included in these rules, in real time.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: In the case of the role of financial frictions – which I consider to be especially important – I am somewhat sceptical of its inclusion in the core principles at this stage because we have not yet reached the state of knowledge to incorporate financial frictions fully in the monetary policy framework in a generally acceptable manner.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
parole_chiave: monetary policy; price stability; transmission mechanism
frase: There is, however, a notable omission in the list of the key principles to guide the thinking at central banks and the conduct of monetary policy: the role of money, or more precisely monetary and credit aggregates, in the monetary policy transmission mechanism and in the assessment of the medium and long-term risks to price stability as well as to financial stability.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: I recognise that in recent years its role and significance has been deemphasised by some economists and at some central banks, but as I have argued before, the fundamental role of money in the conduct of monetary policy should not be ignored, but rather emphasised and further explored.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: And this should be part of the research agenda that will help us to further advance the science of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Despite the progress made over the past decades, there are still important knowledge gaps in our understanding and modelling of the monetary policy transmission mechanism; and there are also a number of analytical and statistical (measurement) challenges that must be addressed in order to further advance the science of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: A comparison with his list of further likely advances in the science of monetary policy showed a very large overlap both with regard to the areas for further research and the reasons given to justify the need for, or likelihood of, further progress.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: In order to enhance our analysis and assessment of the impact of monetary policy on price developments, as well as on output fluctuations and asset price dynamics, in a modern economy with a sophisticated financial sector, priority must be given to the further development of structural models that incorporate a banking sector, other financial intermediaries and a richer specification of the structure and functioning of financial markets.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: The integration of the financial system, and of the banking sector in particular, in a state-of-the-art dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model that is empirically estimated, would provide a theoretically consistent framework – based on sound microfoundations – that would allow an analysis of the role of money and credit – of liquidity and financing conditions – in the transmission of the effects of monetary policy on the economy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Although the task is challenging because of the complexities involved in incorporating a realistic specification of the financial sector – with financial market frictions (or imperfections) – into such models, it is important from a policy point of view that we deepen our understanding of this transmission channel of monetary policy and its implications for price and output dynamics.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: The analysis of the role of money and credit (i) in the transmission of the effects of monetary policy and (ii) as information variables that can provide useful signals for the assessment of risks to price stability and financial stability need not be confined to the further development of DSGE models.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Consequently, a better understanding and modelling of these innovations and processes, as well as of the determinants of asset prices and of the sectoral demand for money and credit, is necessary in order to improve both our economic and monetary analysis and our assessment of the likely impact of a change in the monetary policy stance on financial market conditions and price developments.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: The broader aim of this research on the role of money, credit and the financial system in the monetary transmission mechanism is to enhance the scientific basis – to strengthen the analytical framework – of our policy deliberations.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
parole_chiave: monetary policy; price stability; transmission mechanism
frase: And I am confident that the outcome of this research will provide further theoretical and empirical support to two of the core principles that should guide the conduct of monetary policy: (i) the principle I added on “the role of money and credit in the monetary policy transmission mechanism and the assessment of medium to longer term risks to price stability” and (ii) a generalisation of the principle on “the role of financial frictions for the business cycle” and, I would add, “for financial stability”.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: What is less manifestly obvious is the precise relationship between financial stability considerations and monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Second, and even more challenging, we need to understand in more detailed and verifiable manner the precise relationship between the causes and implications of financial instability and monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Another priority in our research agenda is to enhance our understanding of the way expectations are formed by different agents in the economy, and how they can be managed successfully so as to improve the effectiveness of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Inflation expectations play a crucial role in determining the impact of monetary policy on the economy and in shaping the dynamic response of prices and output to shocks.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: By now it is widely accepted that expectations should, by and large, be formed “rationally” in the sense that they should take into account all relevant available information concerning the structure and functioning of the economy and the factors and policies – notably monetary policy – that may affect future price developments.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: And these assumptions, which essentially relate to the nature and modalities of the associated learning and information extracting processes and the homogeneity of agents, play a crucial role in determining the dynamics of the economy and the magnitude of, and time lags in, the effects of a change in the monetary policy stance on the price level an output over time.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: An important implication of the central role of expectations in the monetary policy transmission process and of the “rationality” of expectations – in a broad sense – is that the effectiveness of monetary policy depends on the expectations of the markets and of the public about future policy actions.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: And this is the fundamental reason why the adoption and public announcement of a quantitative definition of price stability (or an operational inflation objective), the credible commitment of the central bank to this objective, and the effective communication of its policy decisions aimed at achieving this goal are crucial for the anchoring of inflation expectations to price stability.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Our own experience and the track record of the ECB since 1999 have been very positive in this respect: despite the fact that the ECB, as a newly created central bank, did not have a previous track record of successful policy-making, financial markets immediately understood the ECB’s commitment to price stability as credible and factored it in their expectations.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Ever since 1999, all financial market indicators and private sector forecasts suggest that expectations of future inflation have remained remarkably well anchored to the ECB’s definition of price stability.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: For example, expectations derived from the prices of nominal and indexed-linked bonds provide compelling evidence that long-term inflation expectations are well anchored in the euro area.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: However, while market expectations appear to be “rational” in that they are in line with the ECB’s commitment and demonstrated ability to preserve price stability, the process of expectation formation among the general public appears to be rather more complex.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Survey evidence suggests that in a number of euro area countries, a portion of the general public perceives inflation to deviate sometimes significantly from actual inflation or expects inflation to remain at elevated levels which bear little resemblance to actually recorded inflation or market expectations of future inflation.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Among the various forms of uncertainty that central bankers face, the uncertainty about how the policy instrument affects inflation and economic activity – the monetary transmission mechanism – and the uncertainty about the (statistical) measurement of the current state of the economy – the data – appear to weigh particularly heavily.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Central bankers need to have a good understanding of the timing and the ultimate effects of changes in the monetary policy instruments on inflation and economic activity.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: For this purpose, monetary policy-making requires more than just the qualitative information that theory provides.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Model uncertainty suggests that further analysis of the robustness of the effects of monetary policy actions across a variety of models would be valuable.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: This is especially applicable to variables that are not directly observable, but which are relevant for policy formulation, such as the potential output growth and the equilibrium values of the real unemployment rate and the real interest rate.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: To sum up, over the past decades, tremendous progress has been made towards making monetary policy more of a science.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Undoubtedly, this has contributed to enhancing the effectiveness of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: At the same time, there is still room – and indeed a need – to further advance the scientific elements of monetary policy-making by addressing a number of conceptual, methodological and empirical challenges.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Technological advances, financial innovations, the process of globalisation, even changing preferences, are influencing the structure and functioning of markets and the monetary policy transmission mechanism.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Monetary policy-makers have to take decisions against the background of the evolving economic environment and then face a host of uncertainties.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Moreover, these observations have two important implications for monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: First, the ability to combine “science and art” in a well-structured, balanced, prudent and effective way will always remain a key feature of the successful performance of monetary policy.

titolo: The science of monetary policy: past advances and future challenges
frase: Second, in an environment of continuous change and considerable uncertainty, it is essential that central banks provide an anchor of stability and certainty: through their commitment to and delivery of price stability.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: Financial integration is also crucial, as it enhances the smooth and effective transmission of the single monetary policy throughout the euro area.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: Lack of openness in some countries increases risks of wage pressures as labour markets tighten.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: Last year, the inflation dispersion was only 0.7 percentage point.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: Let me stress that the sustained differences in economic growth or inflation rates between some euro area countries are absolutely normal in a monetary union, to the extent that they are related to catching-up phenomena.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: But before addressing this issue, let me stress that the ECB’s single monetary policy contributes to the proper functioning of adjustment mechanisms within the euro area by ensuring price stability, i.e.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: In other words, the social partners, when agreeing on wage increases, and also national authorities, when preparing their budgets or designing policies in their fields of responsibility, should be, and, as a matter of fact, are fully confident that we, at the ECB and in the Eurosystem, will deliver price stability.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: Moreover, more integrated financial markets give rise to greater competition, resulting in more favourable financing conditions for consumers and firms.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: For instance, globalisation has undeniably had an impact on the inflation process.

frase: Globalisation can also exert pressure conducive to lower inflation more indirectly, as increasing international competition may have limited the pricing power of domestic corporations.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: Even though the net effect of these counterbalancing forces is mostly believed to have contributed towards reducing inflation, whether and how long this disinflationary effect will last in the future remains an open question.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: For instance, it may allow increased labour inflows to the euro area, which, in certain sectors, would help to reduce bottlenecks in labour markets and hence ease wage pressures.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: As regards monetary policy, Europe can count on the European Central Bank and the Eurosystem to be faithful to their primary objective and solidly anchor inflation expectations in the euro area.

titolo: The process of European economic integration
frase: Furthermore, there are also other factors – independent of globalisation – that can help to explain the decline in global inflation, such as the rapid technological progress and structural reforms that both have helped to increase the growth potential of the economies and thus to facilitate price stability, greater budgetary discipline and finally “better” monetary policy, that have resulted in an enhanced credibility of central banks.

frase: In this regard, the demographic developments I have just described are not the types of shock that may trigger significant and immediate monetary policy responses.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: This notwithstanding, financial markets may already be anticipating some of the effects of population ageing on asset prices, which are of indisputable relevance for monetary policy-makers.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: Consequently, in this speech I would like to share with you some thoughts based on the findings of the economic literature regarding, first, the effects of demographic change on the main macroeconomic variables and, second, the implications for the conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: Changes in savings and investment rates are expected to bring about adjustments in real interest rates, which could be partly tempered with international flows of production factors.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: When thinking about long-term macroeconomic developments, which take time to run their course, it is helpful to try to quantify the real interest rate which, over those extended horizons, equalises domestic savings and investment.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: Now, the predicted declines in investment and savings described so far make the expected effect of ageing on the equilibrium real interest rate ambiguous.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: If investment decelerates or falls faster than domestic savings – at each level of aggregate income – the real interest rate that clears the market for loanable funds is expected to fall, since it is difficult for savers to find profitable investment opportunities.

frase: Alternatively, if domestic savings were to fall faster than investment, the real interest rate would rise to reflect the relative scarcity of financial funds.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: The results of such exercises suggest that ageing is likely to lead to a moderate reduction in real interest rates in the European economies.

frase: On the one hand, some real-world factors may make the true decline in the equilibrium real interest rate larger than estimated in macroeconomic models.

frase: Finally, these models do not usually take into account the effects of ageing on risk premia: if demographic developments were to lead to a substantial increase in government debt, resulting from a lack of sufficient pension reforms, the risk premia embedded in government bond yields would become larger, pushing interest rates upwards and undermining growth prospects.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: I have just mentioned that, as a consequence of ageing, a shortfall in investment relative to domestic savings would put downward pressure on the equilibrium real interest rate.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: The ageing process is therefore expected to contribute to a smooth and minor reduction in the equilibrium real interest rate over the next decades, while current account surpluses in ageing economies could partially mitigate this decline.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: In the second part of my speech, I would like to address the possible effects of ageing on the monetary policy transmission mechanism and the objective of the central bank.

frase: Apart from the potential effects of ageing on the yield curve, how would the transmission mechanism of monetary policy change with an older population?

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: Therefore, the transmission channel of monetary policy may be affected by ageing.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: I would now like to stress that for a price-stability oriented central bank ageing also creates an environment in which the support for price stability will be reinforced.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: In this environment, where a larger fraction of households’ wealth is invested in nominal assets, price stability would be even more important for households.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: This is why a credible commitment to maintaining price stability and, as a reflection, an orderly financial environment is and will remain so important for maintaining the standard of living of European citizens, particularly for the poorest and the most vulnerable.

titolo: The monetary policy implications of ageing
frase: And second, escalating wealth-to-GDP ratios in ageing societies could render the wealth channel more important for the transmission of monetary policy actions, as the sensitivity of consumption and investment to asset prices is likely to increase.

frase: It implies that on the basis of the expected favourable medium-term outlook for real GDP growth, the monetary policy stance is still on the accommodative side and that the ECB should act in a timely and effective manner to ensure that risks to price stability over the medium term do not materialise.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: At the same time, given the increase in uncertainty surrounding the economic outlook, it is prudent and appropriate to wait and gather additional information before drawing any firm conclusions for monetary policy.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: I should note that the uncertainty we face is not only related to the likelihood of some specific risks materialising that could affect the financial and product markets, but it also pertains to the ongoing process of adjustment of the attitudes toward risk of financial institutions and other market participants, which could have a bearing on financing conditions.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: Having said that, I would like to stress that the ECB’s monetary policy is firmly geared towards its primary objective of preserving price stability.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: And especially during a period of increased uncertainty and market volatility, it is important that inflation expectations remain firmly anchored to price stability.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: Having presented these reflections concerning the financial market turmoil, the current macroeconomic outlook and our monetary policy stance, allow me to conclude by touching upon some broader considerations regarding the role and policies of central banks and, in particular, of the European Central Bank.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: The primary objective of the ECB – and the Eurosystem as a whole – is to maintain price stability.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: Furthermore, the ECB is to support the general economic policies of the Union, aiming among other goals at sustainable economic growth, provided that this is possible without prejudice to the objective of price stability.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: The objectives of price stability and financial stability are interrelated and mutually reinforcing, in that both serve to create conditions which are a prerequisite for economic growth and prosperity.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: Why should the preservation of price stability be the primary, overriding objective of monetary policy?

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: First, monetary policy, with the available instruments at its disposal, can control effectively the price level over the medium and longer run.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: Second, by contrast, monetary policy cannot influence the level or rate of growth of aggregate output in a permanent manner (or to any significant extent).

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: Third, although in the short term a change in the monetary policy stance could affect economic activity under certain circumstances, such effects are uncertain, cannot be systematically exploited to stabilise the business cycle and there is a risk that a countercyclical monetary policy could be counterproductive and jeopardise the attainment of the price stability goal.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: Most importantly, by establishing an environment of price stability, a central bank contributes in a fundamental, though indirect way, to sustainable economic growth, since in such an environment reduced inflation uncertainty, inflation expectations anchored to price stability and low levels of long-term interest rates foster sustainable growth.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: For all these reasons, the mandates of most central banks in the advanced economies give primacy to the price stability objective.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: It is interesting to note that a major central bank that has a dual mandate has emphasised in its communication some of the messages that I have stressed here, namely that price stability is a necessary precondition for growth.

titolo: The financial market turmoil, the European economy, and the role of the European Central Bank
frase: It is, therefore, appropriate not to ignore the conclusions of theory and the lessons of past experience when discussing the objectives of monetary policy.

frase: I explained earlier at length the ECB’s monetary policy stance in order to fulfil its objective of preserving price stability.

frase: Against the background of the tenth anniversary of the European Central Bank (ECB) in June of this year and of the euro seven months later, I very much welcome the opportunity to take stock of our single monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: Key to the success of the euro has been the ECB’s sustained high level of credibility in effectively safeguarding price stability in the euro area.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: The constituent features of the institutional framework for the single monetary policy are: a clear mandate to safeguard price stability in the euro area, and full independence of the ECB in the pursuit of this mandate.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: Indeed, price stability and independence are the key features of modern central banks’ institutional architecture worldwide, not just in Europe.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: Monetary Policy has been depoliticised and denationalised.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: The mandate of the ECB is laid down in Article 105 of the Treaty, which clearly states that the primary objective of the ECB shall be to maintain price stability in the euro area.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: This specification reflects the fundamental insight that price stability is conducive to sustainable economic growth, job creation, prosperity and social stability.

frase: Why is price stability crucial?

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: Price stability allows people to concentrate on productive activities rather than on strategies to protect their wealth and income against inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: This is of particular benefit to the weakest groups of society, which have only limited possibilities for hedging against inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: In this sense, price stability also makes an important contribution to social stability.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: One should never forget that history is littered with episodes of inflation or deflation that paved the way for social upheavals and political instability, and even chaos.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: In addition, the medium-term orientation of the ECB’s monetary policy strategy is instrumental in ensuring that price stability is pursued without introducing unnecessary volatility in economic activity and financial conditions in response to exogenous shocks, such as an increase in oil prices.

frase: Central bank independence is a necessary precondition for monetary policy to be credibly and effectively geared to price stability, since it protects monetary policy from detrimental political interferences.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: In the absence of central bank independence, monetary policy can at any time be exposed to political pressures, motivated, for example, by short-term or short-sighted policy considerations, to boost output temporarily in the short run at the expense of higher inflation in the longer run.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: It comprises a definition of price stability to render our mandate operational, and a broad-based analysis of the risks to price stability in the context of our two-pillar framework.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: The ECB defines its price stability objective as a year-on-year increase in the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) for the euro area of below, but close to 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: By referring to an increase in the HICP of below but close to 2%, the ECB has made it clear that HICP inflation of 2% or above, but also very low or negative rates of inflation are not consistent with its price stability objective.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: Therefore, we aim at a low positive inflation rate in order to mitigate the detrimental effects of inflation on the euro area economies while at the same time maintaining a sufficient safety margin against potential risks of deflation.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: Another fundamental aspect of our definition of price stability is its medium-term horizon, which means that we do not attempt to fine-tune the inflation rate at short horizons, but aim at keeping inflation below but close to 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Monetary policy and the euro
frase: The medium-term orientation of our strategy acknowledges that – in view of long, variable and uncertain transmission lags – monetary policy is not equipped to control price developments at short horizons.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: I will demonstrate how certain longstanding principles of sound central banking – which were embedded in our monetary policy framework from the outset – have guided our deliberations and actions through the recent turbulent times.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: On the basis of our experience during this challenging period, I will then distil a few key lessons for central banks, in particular regarding the conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: The cumulated experiences of central banks over a long period of time, together with developments in modern economic theory, have forged a set of widely-accepted general principles for the conduct of sound monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: First, monetary policy must be given a clear and unambiguous mandate to maintain price stability.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: Given the “long-run neutrality” of money and monetary policy – surely one of the most widely-accepted principles in modern macroeconomic thinking – the only feasible objective for monetary policy is to control the price level, since ultimately it is impotent with respect to the level of real income or employment.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: Private longer-term inflation expectations must be securely anchored at levels consistent with price stability.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: To achieve this, the central bank must always be ready – and be seen to be ready – to take whatever action is necessary to deliver price stability.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: Making this commitment credible requires, in turn, that the central bank operates under the appropriate institutional set-up and that it develops, over time, a track record demonstrating its willingness and capacity to act so as to maintain price stability.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: A large body of theoretical and empirical literature has established that central bank independence is conducive to maintaining price stability.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: Given the many short-term pressures they face to deviate from the objective of price stability, the involvement of politicians in monetary policy only serves to undermine its credibility and thereby its effectiveness.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: Transparency and accountability also buttress the credibility of the central bank’s commitment to price stability, by ensuring that the public understand that the motivation behind monetary policy decisions is the achievement of the primary objective.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: Fifth, monetary policy must maintain a medium-term orientation.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: The long and variable lags that characterise the monetary policy transmission process make it impossible for monetary policy to offset the inevitable unanticipated shocks that buffet the economy and the price level in the short-run.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: Attempts to “fine tune” inflation developments on a month-to-month basis are doomed to fail and would only introduce additional unnecessary volatility into the economy.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: Sixth, monetary policy must be underpinned by a comprehensive analytical framework, which ensures that all information needed to take monetary policy decisions is available to policy makers in a form that supports efficient and timely decision-making.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: Given the importance to maintaining credibility and a medium-term orientation, such a framework must include a thorough analysis of monetary and credit developments, reflecting the necessarily monetary nature of inflation over the longer term.

titolo: Monetary policy during the financial turmoil: what have we learned?
frase: Finally, a clear distinction must be maintained between: on the one hand, the determination of the monetary policy stance required to maintain price stability; and, on the other hand, the provision of liquidity to the money market.

titolo: Credible alertness revisited

titolo: Credible alertness revisited

titolo: Credible alertness revisited
frase: Given that our mandate requires the maintenance of price stability on an ongoing and continuous basis, rather than at any specific arbitrary horizon, we consider it important to monitor the slow accumulation of unsustainable financial imbalances which pose a threat to macroeconomic and price stability over the longer term.

titolo: Credible alertness revisited
frase: Maintaining a medium-term orientation, keeping a close eye on monetary and credit dynamics, and adopting a broader, stability-oriented view of policy making – which are key elements of the ECB’s monetary policy strategy – supports this approach.

titolo: Credible alertness revisited

titolo: Credible alertness revisited

titolo: Credible alertness revisited
frase: Even in the face of the exceptional challenges of recent years, the standard interest rate instrument has remained a crucial component of the central bank armoury as regards monetary policy.

titolo: Credible alertness revisited
frase: Our interest rate decisions should be judged on their effectiveness, understood as the contribution they make to the achievement of the ECB’s objective of maintaining price stability.

titolo: Credible alertness revisited
frase: In this respect, understanding the transmission mechanism of monetary policy is crucial.

titolo: Credible alertness revisited
frase: In this literature, it is widely recognised that households and firms’ spending decisions are affected by longer-term interest rates, rather than the very short-term rates steered in monetary policy operations.

titolo: Credible alertness revisited

titolo: Credible alertness revisited

titolo: Credible alertness revisited

titolo: Credible alertness revisited

titolo: Credible alertness revisited

titolo: Credible alertness revisited

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry
frase: Let me start with price stability.

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry
frase: In an economy like the euro area, where around three quarters of firms’ financing comes from banks, fragmentation has very severe consequences for the real economy, for investment and employment and ultimately for price stability.

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry
frase: We therefore acted to remove unfounded fears about the euro and to safeguard our ability to ensure price stability for the whole euro area.

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry
frase: It is for this reason that there is a requirement of countries having an adjustment programme to be considered for Outright Monetary Transactions (OMTs).

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry
frase: And there is one more important lesson from 2012 that we must keep in mind: measures to stabilise the euro area, particularly the OMTs, are not only essential for price stability.

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry
frase: The crisis has several facets that are of different importance in different countries: there is a debt crisis that needs fiscal consolidation; there is a competitiveness crisis that needs structural reforms; there is a banking crisis that needs a strong financial union; and there is a confidence crisis that needs strong commitment by all policy-makers, including by the central bank expressed through our programme of OMTs.

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry

titolo: Address at the New Year's Reception of the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: This is also the case in the monetary policy-making arena, where new strategic aspects are being promoted and debated around the globe.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: In the second and main part of my remarks I would, therefore, like to focus on two examples of such ‘innovative’ strategic thinking for monetary policy, assessing them from a euro area perspective.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: The first example concerns the objective of monetary policy.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Central banks typically rely on financial markets to transmit their monetary policy intentions to the real economy.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Ensuring that the expectations of firms and households regarding future inflation remain well-anchored is of the essence for keeping inflation in check.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: The first element has been the swift reduction of our key policy rates to historically low levels in response to the emergence of downside risks to price stability.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: This is what is considered “standard” monetary policy action.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: The second element has entailed a host of measures to address dislocations in financial markets that were preventing the permissive monetary policy interest rates to be fully and evenly reflected in the lending conditions faced by households and firms across the euro area.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: This set of measures, therefore, serves to improve financing conditions over and above what can be achieved through reductions in the key ECB interest rates.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: On the one hand, central banks were faced with the risk of a financial meltdown, which would have had profound implications for the real economy and which posed a serious threat to price stability.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Increasing the numerical definition of price stability Let me now turn to the discussion of ‘innovative’ ideas on strategic aspects of monetary policy.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Since the early 1980s, a broad consensus has emerged across advanced economies which has elevated price stability to the main – although not always the sole – objective of monetary policy.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Indeed, through the fixed-exchange-rate policy for the krone vis-à-vis the euro, Danmarks Nationalbank is effectively also among the central banks aiming at maintaining price stability.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: In most cases, the mandate for pursuing price stability has been operationalised by defining a numerical value for inflation that the central bank should aim to deliver.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: In the wake of the crisis, however, a number of pundits have called for an increase in the inflation rate that central banks should aim for.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Proponents of this approach argue that this is a way to provide more monetary policy stimulus to the economy when nominal short-term interest rates – the instrument typically employed by central banks – cannot be reduced further because they are at zero, or close to zero.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: The rationale is that a higher inflation objective, if credible, would prompt firms and households to revise their expectations regarding future inflation upwards.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: By doing so, it would reduce further down real interest rates, which are not necessarily constrained by zero.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: As real – rather than nominal – interest rates matter for economic decisions such as investment and consumption, this change should promote economic activity.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: It is therefore argued that switching to a higher numerical aim for inflation will bring about a one-off accommodative effect when it is adopted.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: To explain my concerns, I shall step back for a moment and clarify an aspect of the ECB’s monetary policy framework that is subtle, but in my view important.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: By contrast to many central banks around the world, the ECB does not practice inflation targeting.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: The ECB has been mandated by the Treaty (Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union) to maintain price stability over the medium term.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: The mandate itself does not entail a precise definition of what price stability means in practice.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: The Governing Council, therefore, decided to identify inflation values consistent with conditions of price stability.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Price stability conditions do not necessarily entail stable prices, that is to say zero inflation.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Inflation levels which are sufficiently contained to not interfere with economic choices are to be considered indicative of a stable monetary environment, and therefore of price stability.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Inflation impinges on a large array of economic activities.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Moreover, inflation – especially if it is volatile – creates distortions in the information content of relative prices in the economy.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: The upshot is that the rate of inflation, above which distortions of economic decision-making start becoming material, is not a matter of policy preference, like an inflation target.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Moreover, the direction and size of the effect of any such changes on the non-distortive inflation rate is not a priori clear.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Where does this leave us on the proposal to increase the numerical objective pursued by monetary policy?

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: An inflation target can be changed to reflect shifting policy tastes and moving priorities.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: But a quantitative definition of price stability is a range of inflation values that can be qualified as unproblematic for economic decision-making.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: For a central bank like the ECB, wedded to a range of inflation values that can be characterised as indicative of stable prices, a change to this range – and notably to its upper quantitative limit – is not conceivable barring analysis that convincingly argues for a wider range and larger values.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: A change not justified on these bases would create permanent damage to our ability to steer inflation expectations and contain inflation volatility.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: A loss of credibility can lead to an overshooting of inflation expectations.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: This would require a disproportionate withdrawal of monetary policy accommodation in the future to reign in inflation.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Even if the central bank is successful in engineering precisely the intended permissive conditions as measured by a real interest rate decline, it is far from clear that this would indeed generate real effects even in the short-term.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Overall, therefore, one risks trading very uncertain gains – in terms of immediate policy accommodation – against rather certain costs – in terms of higher inflation, possibly for an indefinite period.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: But for some of the proponents of increasing the central bank’s inflation objective this proposal is not motivated by a perceived need to stimulate aggregate demand when nominal interest rates are at zero or close to zero.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: According to this argument, a higher inflation objective makes it less likely that the economy may get trapped in a destructive debt-deflation spiral of the type described by Irving Fisher.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: In the midst of the Great Depression, Fisher put forward a theory of economic crises that centred on the mutually reinforcing effects between over-indebtedness and deflation.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Deflation in turn causes the real debt and interest burden to go up, thereby triggering a new bout of distressed asset sales and deleveraging and trapping the economy in a vicious circle.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Deflation poses risks to the economy that – in some respects – are even more intractable than inflation.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: It is for this reason that the Governing Council’s definition of price stability rules out negative inflation values.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Moreover, the Governing Council’s policy aim (within the range of positive inflation rates that are consistent with price stability) is sufficiently close to the upper bound of the range to stave off the risk that negative price shocks may unleash a self-reinforcing downward inflation spiral.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: But engineering financial repression in order to facilitate balance sheet adjustment would clearly violate the mandate to maintain price stability as a primary objective conferred upon the ECB by the Treaty.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Earlier in my remarks I referred to the central bank’s steering of inflation expectations as an illustration of the notion of control.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: I am very sceptical whether increasing the numerical definition of price stability helps in either of these dimensions.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Engaging in communication regarding the future path of policy rates Let me now turn to the second example of an innovative proposal for monetary policy that I would like to discuss today.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: As I already mentioned, central banks typically conduct monetary policy by steering nominal short-term interest rates.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: It is, however, widely accepted that it is primarily long-term interest rates that matter for the main economic decisions that the central bank wants to influence.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: How is it then that monetary policy can have an impact on the economy?

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Well, one can think of long-term interest rates as comprising two elements: expectations regarding the future evolution of short-term rates; and premia.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Changes in the current policy rate are typically interpreted by markets to also signal changes for short-term rates in the future.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: In normal times, this signalling channel works well and market expectations tend to be in line with monetary policy makers’ intended long-term rates.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: The risk is that long-term rates may drift away from the central bank’s intended path, in which case financing conditions in the economy will not properly reflect the stance of monetary policy.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Some academic economists have advocated that, particularly in such a situation, the central bank should engage in active communication regarding the future path of policy rates.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: If this commitment is sufficiently credible, it will be effective in steering expectations regarding future interest rates and so influence the first component of long-term interest rates to which I was referring before.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: This is turn, will allow the central bank to deliver accommodative financing conditions in the economy over a certain horizon.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: But the decomposition of long-term rates I mentioned a few moments ago suggests that there is also another possible way for the central bank to deliver appropriate financing conditions in the economy.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: I would argue that the assessment regarding which approach is more appropriate depends on the particular situation each monetary policy maker faces.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: The approach focusing on communication regarding the future path of short-term interest rates is in principle applicable to a situation where there is a need to provide general, across the board, stimulus to the economy.

titolo: Speech on the occasion of the “Annual Danish Top Executive Summit 2013”
frase: Moreover, it applies in currency areas where financing conditions are more or less homogeneous throughout segments of the financial market and of the currency space.

frase: On crisis prevention, maintaining an environment of price stability is the best contribution that monetary policy can make to supporting financial stability.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: Here is my “to do” and “not to do” list on monetary policy in crisis times, expanding a little on Bagehot.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: Support functioning monetary transmission mechanism (via banks and markets), do not guarantee uniform financing conditions or suppress fundamentally justified risk premia.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: Preserve singleness of monetary policy, do not compensate need for political commitment to keep composition of currency area intact.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: Fulfil the duty of fire-fighting in crisis to preserve financial and ultimately price stability, but keep a medium-term perspective and do not neglect unintended consequences and adverse side-effects from protracted non-standard measures on financial institutions and functioning.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: Take responsibility and credit for averting Armageddon, but do not overstate what monetary policy can and cannot do.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: At the same time, both modalities are in principle also part of the toolkit of traditional instruments for monetary policy operations.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: Most of the ECB’s non-standard measures have been motivated by impairments in the transmission of monetary policy, in particular with respect to impaired interbank markets, bank funding and bank lending channels as well as financial market segments with particular relevance as benchmarks (governments bonds) or as a bank funding instrument (covered bonds).

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: Additional obstacles to the smooth transmission of the ECB’ monetary policy stance across the euro area arise from financial fragmentation that exacerbates heterogeneity across countries that may exist in part for fundamentally justified reasons.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: In practice this distinction is the more difficult to draw, the more widespread transmission impairments become and the closer policy rates are to the lower bound.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: In both dimensions, it is nonetheless useful to recall again the limits of monetary policy.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: Monetary policy transmission may be hampered at times where banks, in particular, but also non-financial sectors need to repair their balance sheets.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: These are cases where standard monetary policy may be “pushing on a string” (in the words of John Maynard Keynes).

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: These have to be addressed primarily outside the realm of monetary policy, even if the latter could potentially perform a catalytical role in some circumstances.

frase: Regulatory impact on financial markets and monetary policy: the financial transaction tax Finally, let me turn briefly to the financial transaction tax [FTT], as an example where government regulation may have adverse consequences on financial markets and monetary policy transmission.

titolo: The euro and the ECB: Perspectives and challenges ahead
frase: Looking at the specific FTT proposal published by the EU Commission on 14 February, nonetheless attention needs to be drawn to possible negative implications for the implementation of monetary policy and financial stability:

frase: In particular, a fully-fledged banking union, as complement to monetary union supports financial integration and monetary policy transmission and hence ultimately reduces the burden on monetary policy.

titolo: The euro, monetary policy and reforms
frase: The origins of the crisis in the euro area Until a few years ago monetary policy was considered a textbook discipline, almost a mechanical skill involving the implementation of computational applications by conscientious experts.

titolo: The euro, monetary policy and reforms

titolo: The euro, monetary policy and reforms
frase: This brief scrutiny of the origins of the crisis in the euro area shows how the response of economic policy cannot be other than composite: in it, monetary policy plays an important but by no means exclusive role.
