titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Looking ahead, the question is: how will our monetary policy toolbox evolve in the foreseeable future?

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Monetary policy will evolve in a data-dependent and time-consistent manner.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: The transition towards a normalisation will begin once we have established that there is a sustained adjustment in the path of inflation.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Our assessment will be based on three criteria for the inflation outlook: convergence, confidence and resilience.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: First, convergence: headline inflation will have to be on course to reach levels below, but close to, 2% by the end point of a meaningful medium-term horizon.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Two things are noteworthy here: the salience of our inflation aim and the forward-looking perspective.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: There should be no doubt about our steadfast commitment to secure a sustained return of inflation rates towards levels that are below, but close to,, 2%.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: And the perspective should be forward-looking because our monetary policy framework directs us to shape monetary policy with a firm medium-term orientation.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Since the start of Monetary Union, the ECB’s monetary policy has always been formed with a view to stabilising medium-term headline inflation around levels that are most consistent with our price stability definition.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: The Governing Council wants to be sure that the expectation of an upward adjustment in inflation has a sufficiently high probability of being realised and is being met on a sustainable basis, i.e.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: In other words, we need to build strong confidence in the accuracy of our baseline outlook for inflation: the range of possible outcomes around that baseline path should be reasonably contained.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: At our last Governing Council meeting, we have communicated our increasing confidence that inflation will converge towards our inflation aim of below, but close, to 2%.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: How can we substantiate today that inflation convergence has sufficiently strong legs to support its upward trajectory towards our aim?

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: By looking at a broad range of indicators of price pressures, for example measures of inflation trends, notably including core inflation indices.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: As these underlying inflation statistics – available today – contain information that is valuable for predicting the level of headline inflation in the future, when short-term shocks that may influence its level today have faded away, we want to cross-check our medium-term projections for headline inflation with these measures.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: In parallel, an eye on capacity utilisation and the extent of unutilised resources can help reinforce our confidence in inflation convergence as a more robust real economy is likely to support a build-up of broad-based price pressures looking forward.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Our third criterion, resilience, measures the robustness of inflation convergence to a partial withdrawal of monetary policy accommodation.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: If the inflation outlook is overly dependent on monetary support, the upward adjustment cannot be considered sustained.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: So, we want to verify that the path would be maintained even in less supportive monetary policy conditions.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Patience is necessary because it takes time for price pressures to build up, and to be reflected in the information that forms the basis for our assessment of progress towards a sustained adjustment in the path of inflation.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Persistence is necessary because the recovery in inflation is, in itself, a consequence of the prevailing accommodative monetary policy stance.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Even if incoming data were to validate the expectation of a gradual build-up of inflationary pressures, this would not be sufficient to affirm a sustained adjustment, if even less supportive monetary policy conditions were to imperil the inflation trajectory.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Once the Governing Council judges that the three criteria for sustained adjustment have been met, net asset purchases will expire, in line with our guidance.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: From that point in time, the evolution of inflation will remain conditional on reinvestments continuing for an extended period of time and on policy rates remaining at their present levels well past the end of our net asset purchases.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: The stock of long-duration assets held in our portfolio will continue to put downward pressure on longer-term interest rates well beyond the end of our net purchases.

titolo: Maintaining price stability with unconventional monetary policy
frase: Policy rates remaining at their present levels well past the end of our net purchases will contribute to holding the short to intermediate portions of the yield curve in check for as long as necessary, thereby ensuring that financial conditions remain consistent with a sustained adjustment of inflation.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: The ECB’s position on the matter has been constant: the provision of central bank liquidity – be it through monetary policy credit operations or emergency liquidity assistance, should not be automatically assumed in resolution planning.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Moving on to the objectives, liquidity can be provided to serve the primary objective of maintaining price stability.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: One is in the form of Eurosystem monetary policy operations.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Our constitutional mandate requests that we at all times to pursue the Eurosystem’s price stability objective in line with a functioning open market economy.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Eurosystem monetary policy has to be provided to an entity that participates in the monetary policy transmission mechanism.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Participating in monetary policy transmission means in principle channelling liquidity to the real economy.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Extending life-lines to institutions outside the monetary policy transmission mechanism is structural or economic policy or financial stability.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: In addition, the provision of Eurosystem monetary policy liquidity must also comply with other requirements set down by primary law, notably with the requirement that lending is based on adequate collateral and the prohibition of monetary financing.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: On the basis of this fundamental requirement, the Eurosystem defines the rules and conditions for collateral to be acceptable, or “adequate”, for monetary policy purposes.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Adequate collateral for the Eurosystem’s monetary policy framework means, first, that collateral must fully protect the central bank against losses in credit operations as these losses are in principle, shared.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: These requirements are even more strict in the case of monetary policy liquidity than for emergency liquidity assistance.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: For example, in the case of the asset separation tool, liquidity can be provided to the solvent part of the bank that is participating in monetary policy transmission and not in order to finance the separation itself.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Liquidity can be provided under the generally applicable monetary policy rules and respecting the limits set out in the Treaty and any Governing Council decisions.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: In principle, such an entity could still have recourse to Eurosystem monetary policy liquidity provided that it complies with the counterparty eligibility criteria, in particular that it is financially sound and has sufficient eligible collateral.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: However, to address the uncertainty and the associated risk in the Eurosystem’s counterparty framework, our rules provide that the entity’s access to Eurosystem monetary policy credit instruments is frozen at the level prevailing at the time it is determined as failing or likely to fail.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Moreover, if necessary, the Governing Council can also impose further restrictions on the grounds of prudence, including suspending access to monetary policy credit operations for an entity with very low capital ratios.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Since the terms of its access to Eurosystem monetary policy credit operations will have been frozen and perhaps even further restricted, it will not be able to meet its increased liquidity needs through this means.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Since the provision of ELA can interfere with implementation of the single monetary policy (as it is a parallel source of liquidity to the single monetary policy), the Governing Council needs to be informed of the ELA operation in a timely manner.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: First of all, there are some clear-cut situations where no liquidity can be provided by a central bank, be it under the monetary policy framework or ELA.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Let us assume that it is no longer contributing to monetary policy transmission, because it no longer channels liquidity to the real economy and is in the process of being wound down.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: Wind-down entities, whose main purpose is the gradual divestment of their assets and the cessation of their business, have been excluded from access to monetary policy credit operations.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: I can say, though, that in situations in which the failing counterparty continues to exist, its restored solvency will first have to be confirmed by the competent supervisory authority before the Governing Council will decide to “unfreeze” its access to Eurosystem monetary policy liquidity.

titolo: The limits of central bank financing in resolution
frase: The provision of central bank liquidity will be the independent and ad hoc decision of the Eurosystem under the respective frameworks for monetary policy and potential emergency lending not interfering with monetary policy.

frase: This confirms that the portfolio rebalancing channel has been instrumental in delivering the intended benefits of our quantitative easing.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Low inflation risk and bond term premia This brings me to my second factor.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: One feature that may cause global investors to rebalance their portfolios in the future is a reappraisal of the prevailing outlook for inflation and, hence, for monetary policy across advanced economies.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Such a reappraisal may occur as we are currently observing that the long period of very low global inflation may have affected investors’ deep-seated beliefs about the future.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: This is most visible when looking at current levels of long-term inflation risk premia in both the United States and the euro area.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Here we have a decomposition of long-term inflation-linked bonds and swaps into the same two components that I showed for nominal bonds on my second slide, namely expected future inflation and an inflation risk premium.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: The interpretation is identical: just as investors demand a premium for interest rate uncertainty, they also demand a premium for the uncertainty around the expected future inflation rate.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: In other words, investors are willing to pay a higher price for nominal bonds because they value them as a hedge against low inflation.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: The first is that markets do not question the credibility or ability of central banks to steer the economy towards their inflation aims.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Medium-term inflation expectations per se have remained firmly anchored around levels consistent with price stability.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: This is in line with our reading of survey-based inflation expectations.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: The second message is that markets are, however, deeply sceptical that inflation can surprise much on the upside in the future.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: This is corroborated by survey-based measures, which show that, since the financial crisis, survey participants have been more concerned about deviations in the direction of lower inflation and less concerned about deviations in the direction of higher inflation.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Another way of looking at this is to consider the option-implied distribution of average inflation over the next five years.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Although this distribution reflects expectations over a nearer horizon, it re-emphasises the point that investors assign only a small probability for inflation to surprise much to the upside.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: But it also demonstrates convincingly that markets have by and large priced out deflationary risks in the euro area.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: As you can see, when we announced the APP in January 2015 these risks were considered to be very different.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: I see two main factors that may help explain why investors and professional forecasters are currently casting doubt on positive inflation risks.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Specifically, the peculiar economic cycle that followed the global financial crisis – where very low interest rates around the world succeeded in reducing economic slack and in inflating the value of some assets, but not the prices of goods and services – may have made investors doubt the recurrence of upside inflation risk.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: And this may have led to a downward migration of the future inflation risk distribution.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: This means that large shocks can push the economy into a previously unknown state – in our case a low inflation state – where the absence of, or break with, past regularities, such as the relationship between slack and inflation, may imply a long transition phase to a new steady state.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Worse, if the beliefs I just mentioned guide our actions, then low growth or low inflation can be the result of self-fulfilling pessimistic expectations and can lead to so-called “stagnation traps”.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Whatever the ultimate reasons, does it matter if the inflation risk premium is low?

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: From a monetary policy perspective, what matters most is that inflation expectations remain at levels consistent with price stability.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: At the margin, a low inflation risk premium is positive as it signals increased confidence in the central bank’s ability to achieve its inflation aim.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: But from a financial stability perspective, and here I again refer to previous work presented in the ECB’s Financial Stability Review, a low inflation risk premium may be a matter of concern if it indicates complacency about future adjustments.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: In this case, a reappraisal of investors’ view about future risks to global inflation may cause a correction of global risk premia, in particular in an environment of historically low volatility, as you can see on my next slide.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Incidentally, as oil prices moved higher in recent weeks, the inflation risk premia also rose amid an increasing willingness on the part of investors to hedge against inflation in an environment of strongly declining deflation probabilities.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: For example, a recent survey of 62 fund managers by Bank of America Merrill Lynch revealed that a rise in inflation is thought to be the most underestimated tail risk for global financial markets in 2018.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: One fund manager in two considers a rise in inflation as a risk to current market prices.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: In the euro area, however, we see no such inflation tail risks at the current juncture.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: Inflation is expected to converge only very gradually to levels closer to 2%.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: For this reason, an ample degree of monetary stimulus remains necessary for underlying inflation pressures to continue to build up, and we expect the ECB’s key interest rates to remain at their present levels for an extended period of time, and well past the horizon of our net asset purchases.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: At the same time, we currently see no reason to believe that the distribution of future inflation risks has moved permanently lower.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: It is true that it is taking longer than usual for inflationary pressure to emerge.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: We do see evidence, however, suggesting that market participants globally consider upside risks to future inflation to be limited at present.

titolo: What yield curves are telling us
frase: While this might be a natural corollary of the protracted period of low inflation, it may also be a matter of concern if it indicates complacency over future adjustments.

frase: The robust pace of economic expansion clearly shows that our monetary policy has been effective in preparing for a return of inflation to a rate below, but close to, 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area
frase: Overall, an ample degree of monetary stimulus remains necessary for underlying inflation pressures to continue to build up and support headline inflation developments over the medium term.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area
frase: The investment outlook is also positive, supported not only by a need to modernise the capital stock after years of subdued investment and an improving outlook for profitability, but also by easy financing conditions as our policy measures have passed through financial markets, benefiting businesses and their customers.

frase: The pass-through of monetary policy has become more even.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area

frase: After lingering at levels well below 1% for three years, with occasional dips into negative territory, euro area headline inflation increased towards the end of 2016 and has fluctuated between 1.3% and 1.5% since May of last year.

frase: Looking ahead, on the basis of current futures prices for oil, annual rates of headline inflation are likely to hover around current levels in the coming months.

frase: Measures of underlying inflation remain subdued and have yet to show convincing signs of a sustained upward trend.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area
frase: Muted wage dynamics are one important element keeping a lid on underlying price pressures.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area
frase: In addition to weak productivity developments, the significant degree of remaining labour market slack is limiting wage growth.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area
frase: Looking forward, although there still appears to be a disconnect between growth and inflation, the ongoing economic expansion is expected to further contribute to a narrowing of the output and unemployment gaps.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area
frase: As slack in the economy continues to be absorbed, price pressures will gradually build up and the traditional Phillips curve relationship between inflation and the business cycle should eventually reassert itself.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area
frase: That being said, current estimates still appear to point to a flatter slope of the Phillips curve than in the past, which could be interpreted as an indication that the relationship between economic slack and inflation has weakened.

frase: This weakening might be partly the result of a mismeasurement of slack (because of structural changes in the labour market) or an unstable relationship between slack and inflation over time.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area
frase: Such parallel shifts can arise due to temporary changes in wage and inflation mark-ups or an incipient dis-anchoring of inflation expectations, which is of greater concern to a central bank.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area
frase: Empirically disentangling these factors is extremely difficult, so we need to be mindful of such considerations when discussing the relationship between economic slack and inflation developments.

titolo: Economic developments in the euro area

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economic outlook and the current monetary policy stance

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Introduction I would like to thank Chicago Booth for inviting me to speak at the 2020 U.S. Monetary Policy Forum, sponsored by the Initiative on Global Markets at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, New York, New York.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The focus of this year’s US Monetary Policy Forum, the analysis of unconventional monetary policies, is relevant for many economies, including the euro area.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: As a result, the euro area is at a different point in the monetary policy cycle than other jurisdictions.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The post-crisis monetary policy of the ECB shares many similarities with that of the Federal Reserve: having largely exhausted the conventional space for moving its policy instrument (the short-term policy rate), the ECB turned to a broad set of unconventional measures in pursuit of its statutory objective.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: In particular, the ECB moved into negative territory with its policy rate, employed targeted refinancing operations to promote credit growth and customised its asset purchase programme (APP) to the specific context of the euro area.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Our understanding of the propagation mechanisms of these measures and their efficacy in supporting the economy and the inflation process is steadily deepening.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: In my remarks today, I will discuss our experience with the non-standard measures in our monetary toolbox and explain our monetary policy reaction function in the current below-target inflation environment.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The nature of our reaction function is spelled out in our forward guidance, which provides a unified framework across our different policy instruments – with the guidance on the rate path at its centre – and facilitates automatic adjustment in market conditions in response to shocks that are assessed as influencing the future path of interest rates.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The case for unconventional measures in a low interest rate environment Interest rates in advanced economies have been on a broad downward path for more than three decades and remain close to historical lows.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: As a result, the real neutral interest rate (r*) has declined across advanced economies.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: While the factors that have reduced r* are beyond the control of the central bank, the fact that the level of r* is lower has significant implications for monetary policy: the short-term policy interest rate hits the zero bound more often and, when it does so, remains at the lower bound for a longer time.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Lower real rates reduce the available policy space to counter low inflation.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: This may increase the time it takes for inflation to return to target and this delay may be compounded if a prolonged period of low inflation also erodes inflation expectations.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
parole_chiave: forward guidance; governing council; monetary policy
frase: The ECB’s monetary policy toolbox The Governing Council’s monetary policy reaction function is laid out in our forward guidance on the path of our policy instruments.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
parole_chiave: TLTROs; asset purchases; forward guidance; interest rates
frase: Together with the forward guidance on the rate path at the centre, this provides a coherent framework for the various non-standard measures which the ECB has deployed: negative interest rates, asset purchases and targeted long-term refinancing operations (TLTROs).

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Forward guidance Initially expressed in qualitative terms, the ECB’s rate guidance has evolved over time, with the current formulation made explicitly conditional on a set of criteria regarding the inflation outlook.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The cross-country experience with forward guidance indicates that its effectiveness can differ considerably depending on the type of conditionality attached to the policy rate path.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Conversely, the evidence indicates that rate forward guidance over long horizons, or state-based guidance, is more effective in reducing the sensitivity of asset prices to macroeconomic news.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The state-contingent formulation links the Governing Council’s expected interest rate path to at least two conditions regarding the inflation outlook.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: First, inflation has to “robustly converge to a level sufficiently close to, but below, 2 percent within our projection horizon.” Second, this convergence needs to be “consistently reflected in underlying inflation dynamics”.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The first condition is forward-looking: inflation has to be seen to be converging to a level sufficiently close to 2 percent well before the end point of the horizon: this is the meaning of “robust convergence”.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The second condition is backward-looking: we have to see the robust convergence in future inflation confirmed and verified in actual measures of underlying inflation.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
parole_chiave: asset purchases; forward guidance; interest rates
frase: Importantly, the decision we took last September has established a unified framework for our forward guidance across policy instruments that links the horizon of both our net asset purchases and reinvestments to our forward guidance on the rate path: net purchases are expected to continue until “shortly” before we start raising the key ECB rates; and reinvestments are expected to run “for an extended period of time past the date when we start raising the key ECB interest rates”.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Whereas the forward guidance on the rate path acts on the expectations component of longer-term rates, the asset purchases especially affect term premia, as I will discuss in more detail later on.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Evidence suggests that the enhanced forward guidance we introduced last September is well understood by market participants.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The interest rate lift-off dates in survey-based measures largely coincide with the time at which inflation expectations two years ahead – the horizon of the ECB/Eurosystem staff macroeconomic projections – are around levels close to, but below, 2 percent.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: This indicates that the link between our interest rate forward guidance and the inflation threshold is understood.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: More than that, thanks to its state-contingent nature, our rate guidance provides an automatic stabilisation mechanism that steers rate expectations – and expectations about our asset purchases – as a function of the evolving inflation outlook.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: In practice, we have seen this automatic stabilisation function of our forward guidance operate effectively, with market expectations for a first increase of the policy rate accommodating short-term volatility in the inflation outlook.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: For example, the January 2020 Bloomberg survey pointed to a later lift-off date of the second quarter of 2022 (blue vertical line in Chart 2) in comparison with the Bloomberg survey of April 2019 (yellow vertical line in Chart 2), which coincided with the slight decline in Consensus Economics expectations for annual inflation in the euro area (yellow and blue diamonds in Chart 2).

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Diamonds denote expectations for average annual inflation rates in each year between 2019 and 2029 reported in the Consensus Economics surveys.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
parole_chiave: asset purchase; forward guidance; interest rate; policy rate
frase: In addition to serving as an automatic stabiliser for policy rate expectations, the interest rate forward guidance is also the anchor for expectations of the net asset purchase and reinvestment horizons, as these measures are tightly linked to the interest rate lift-off.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Changes in the inflation outlook that trigger a reappraisal of the lift-off date should therefore also affect the expected end date of net asset purchases and reinvestments, thereby stabilising the long end of the yield curve.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: In fact, this tight link is reflected in the positive co-movement between short and long-term interest rates in response to news that affects the macroeconomic outlook (Chart 3).

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: While the automatic stabilisation function embedded in the forward guidance accommodates any short-term volatility in the outlook, the Governing Council continues to stand ready to adjust all of its instruments, as appropriate, to ensure that inflation moves towards its aim in a sustained manner, in line with its commitment to symmetry.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Overall, the available evidence suggests that the ECB’s rate forward guidance has been and continues to be an effective monetary policy tool and that the transmission of forward guidance to financial conditions and the economy has remained stable over time.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: In part, this reflects the strong explicit conditionality embedded in the ECB’s evolving rate forward guidance statement as well as the interaction with asset purchases and other instruments.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
parole_chiave: forward guidance; interest rate; interest rates
frase: Negative interest rates Within our forward guidance framework, the negative interest rate policy has played a key role in enhancing this automatic stabilisation by lowering the effective lower bound.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: There was no playbook to guide the 2014 decision to push the deposit facility rate – which the ECB pays on bank excess reserves – into negative territory.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Subsequent cuts, including the latest in September 2019, have brought the deposit facility rate to -0.5 percent.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: A corollary of relaxing the lower bound constraint has been that the propagation of negative interest rates through the term structure of interest rates is qualitatively different and more powerful than traditional interest rate cuts occurring in positive territory.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
parole_chiave: interest rate; interest rates; monetary policy
frase: The primary mechanism is the way in which expectations about the future path of monetary policy are reflected in market interest rates when the central bank reduces the overnight interest rate to very low levels.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: If the central bank reduces its policy rate to zero and makes it clear that it will not lower its policy rate any further, then this declared and self-imposed non-negativity restriction influences rate expectations among market participants: looking to the future, they will see rate increases as being more likely than rate decreases.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: As a result, the predictive density of the future rate path will tend to be skewed upward, and interest rates at longer maturities will tend to decline by less than the reduction of the policy rate.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
parole_chiave: interest rate; interest rates; rate cuts
frase: By contrast, under a negative interest rate policy, where future rate cuts are possible, the distribution of rate expectations is more symmetric, putting downward pressure on longer-maturity interest rates.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Rate expectations can even be skewed downwards if the negative rate policy is flanked by communication that the interest rate might be reduced further.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
parole_chiave: forward guidance; governing council; interest rate; interest rates
frase: In this vein, the ECB’s forward guidance has reinforced the negative interest rate policy by stating that the Governing Council expects the ECB’s key interest rates “to remain at their present or lower levels for an extended period of time”.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: EONIA forward curve and its risk-neutral density: before the negative interest rate policy (left side) and after its introduction (right side)

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: This mechanism is illustrated in Chart 4: once the deposit facility rate was brought to a negative level in June 2014 and further reduced in September 2014, the forward curve became markedly flatter and the distribution of expectations more symmetric, with a mild inversion over short to medium-term maturities and no truncation in positive territory (see Chart 4, right side).

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Evidence shows that the improving financing conditions stemming from negative interest rates are feeding their way into the real economy through increased bank loans.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: That the effects of an interest rate cut are more powerful in negative territory can also be seen when considering the “footprint” on the term structure.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Using high-frequency financial market data (“tick data”) to identify monetary surprises, ECB analysis shows that the transmission is more powerful than that of a standard interest rate cut in positive territory, since its effect on the yield curve extends to longer maturities, with a maximum effect around medium-term maturities (see Chart 6).

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Estimated effect of policy rate surprises: standard policy rate surprise (left side) and policy rate surprise in negative territory (right side)

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Moreover, as banks tend to consider risk-free interest rates with short to medium-term maturities as the reference rates for pricing loans to non-financial corporations, the pronounced effects of the negative interest rate policy also propagate through the bank lending channel: our negative rate policy has contributed to a significant decline in lending rates to non-financial corporations since 2014, which in turn has translated into higher loan volumes channelled to the real economy.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The bank-based nature of the euro area economy lends itself to a swift transmission of interest rates to the economy.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: That said, the overall impact of the negative interest rate policy extends beyond the mechanical effects on interest rate margins.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: This leads to higher lending volumes and lower impairment provisioning, while interest rate cuts also generate capital gains on existing securities holdings and improve wholesale funding conditions for banks.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Accordingly, any comprehensive analysis of the determinants of the profitability of the euro area banking system should not focus excessively on the mechanical effect of the limited pass-through of negative policy rates to retail deposit rates.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
parole_chiave: governing council; transmission of monetary policy
frase: Nonetheless, the Governing Council is closely monitoring the risk that the impact of negative rates on bank profitability may impair the transmission of monetary policy to the real economy.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Moreover, the ECB decided last September to introduce a two-tier system for remunerating excess liquidity holdings, with the aim of supporting the bank-based transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The interest rate on such holdings is now tiered, with excess liquidity holdings up to six times the minimum reserve requirements receiving zero interest and holdings beyond that level remunerated at the deposit facility rate of -0.5 percent.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
parole_chiave: accommodative; interest rates; monetary policy; policy rate; policy rates
frase: The implementation of the tiering policy has been smooth: on the one side, it has reduced the direct cost of negative interest rates for banks and thereby helped sustain the pass-through of low policy rates to bank lending rates, while on the other side, money market rates have continued to be well aligned with the policy rate, thereby preserving the positive contribution of negative rates to the accommodative stance of monetary policy.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Finally, we are alert to the possibility that there may be a level for the policy rate below which a policy easing would have perverse effects and in fact lead to a tightening of bank credit conditions: the reversal rate.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Targeted longer-term refinancing operations TLTROs are an effective tool for providing credit easing and are particularly useful if there is a risk of the bank-based transmission mechanism becoming impaired.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Banks can use TLTROs to refinance with the ECB over an extended horizon and at very favourable conditions, provided that they meet the lending targets set by the ECB.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Under the second and third rounds of the programme (TLTRO II and III), borrowing rates in the TLTROs can be as low as the deposit facility rate – which is currently set at -0.5 percent.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: TLTROs lower bank funding costs via two distinct channels – direct and indirect.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The funding cost relief is direct for those banks that use TLTRO financing instead of more expensive market funding.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: In addition, the TLTROs have indirectly contributed to favourable funding conditions on capital markets through the scarcity effects generated by reduced bond issuance from banks that replace market-based funding with TLTRO borrowing.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The effectiveness of TLTROs can be analysed by comparing the change in lending rates between those banks that participated in the operations and those that did not.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The comparison shows that participating banks granted significantly more favourable rates to their corporate clients than their non-participating counterparts, which suggests a sizeable easing of financing conditions for firms, especially in vulnerable countries (see Chart 10).

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area

frase: Introduction My aim in this speech today is to explain the role of monetary policy in the pandemic, with a natural focus on the ECB and the euro area., I will first review the monetary policy measures that we have taken in response to the pandemic before highlighting some of the current economic and financial challenges that confront the euro area.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: I will then explain why the current priority for monetary policy is to ensure favourable financing conditions to support the economic recovery and counteract the negative impact of the pandemic on the projected inflation path.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: The ECB’s monetary policy measures in 2020: a recap The scale and nature of the pandemic shock called for an extraordinary policy response.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: The three main tasks for the ECB since the onset of the pandemic have been: first, to stabilise markets; second, to protect credit supply; and third, to neutralise the pandemic-related downside risks to the inflation path.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: Addressing the first two challenges are high priorities, given that market instability and/or a credit crunch would undermine the running of an effective monetary policy; meeting the third challenge is central to delivering our price stability mandate.

frase: In terms of our monetary policy measures, the combination of the already-low levels of our main policy rates and our previously-installed forward guidance on the future path of interest rates (which links the path of our policy rates to the robust convergence of inflation to our aim) has acted as an automatic stabiliser through the adjustment of policy rate expectations – and hence the entire spectrum of monetary conditions – to pandemic-related changes in the inflation outlook.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: Since additional monetary policy measures were clearly necessary to meet the scale and special nature of the pandemic shock, we introduced a comprehensive package of complementary measures that acted along two main dimensions: (i) asset purchases; and (ii) liquidity operations.

frase: Asset purchases have become an important tool for central banks worldwide to secure price stability in the vicinity of the zero lower bound.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: The experience over the past decade has yielded many insights into how precisely asset purchases affect financial and economic conditions, the latest example being the response to the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: There is by now broad consensus that asset purchases can support economic growth and inflation in three main ways: first, through the market stabilisation channel, by which asset purchases provide liquidity when there are deep dislocations in financial markets; second, through the portfolio rebalancing channel, by which asset purchases reduce the aggregate amount of duration risk to be held by price-sensitive investors, inducing a shift into other, riskier assets in the economy and thereby supporting their value; and, third, through the signalling channel, by which asset purchases signal the intention of central banks to keep policy rates lower for longer.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Dual rates in the TLTROs Our TLTROs, which were first launched in June 2014, support bank-based transmission and ensure continued credit intermediation through the banking system by offering particularly favourable lending conditions to banks meeting a pre-defined lending threshold.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The third series of TLTROs started in September 2019.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The ECB therefore embarked on a major innovation in the design of our lending operations: we decided to offer longer-term funding under the TLTROs during the pandemic period at interest rates below the DFR, the rate at which banks can deposit liquidity overnight with the Eurosystem, conditional on participating banks meeting pre-defined lending thresholds.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: By disconnecting the lending rate from the DFR we were able to effectively reduce the funding costs of those banks that continued to support the real economy, without having to adjust our interest rate corridor, thereby preserving banks’ lending margins and avoiding potential negative side effects from a further rate cut.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Banks’ participation in these liquidity-providing operations has been substantial (Chart 4, left-hand panel): the overall TLTRO III take-up currently represents around one third of our total monetary policy assets.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The PEPP: large and flexible The second main policy response was the announcement of additional private and public sector asset purchases.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: While the first response to the pandemic on 12 March 2020 included the announcement of an additional envelope of €120 billion under our regular asset purchase programme (APP), it quickly became clear that the APP was not an adequate tool to deal with the sudden and severe dislocations in euro area bond markets when the crisis hit with full force.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Therefore, on 18 March 2020 the ECB’s Governing Council announced a new asset purchase programme of unprecedented size, with an eventual overall envelope of €1,850 billion after two further expansions in June and December of the same year.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: This is why we equipped the PEPP with the flexibility to adjust the volume of purchases over time, across asset classes and among jurisdictions.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In retrospect, it turned out that, after we proved our determination to stabilise financial markets and stave off fragmentation risks at the beginning of the crisis, having the option of flexibility – with the clear commitment to use it as necessary – was largely sufficient to preserve the integrity of the monetary policy transmission mechanism.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Under the PEPP, we reduced the minimum maturity of eligible assets and expanded our support to the commercial paper market.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The PEPP’s flexibility probably contributed to lowering the spread of the euro area GDP-weighted yield over risk-free rates quickly after the announcement of the PEPP (Chart 7).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In turn, the PEPP’s contribution to an appropriately calibrated monetary policy stance became more important with a view to countering the downward impact of the pandemic shock on the path of inflation.

frase: This shift made the PEPP more similar to our regular asset purchase programme, the APP, under which net asset purchases are likely to continue for some time once net purchases under the PEPP have come to an end.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Beyond the direct effects, our various crisis measures proved to mutually reinforce each other, thereby also amplifying the overall accommodative impact of our policy response.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: For example, negative rates strengthen the portfolio rebalancing effect from asset purchases as investors aim to avoid negative interest rates.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Asset purchases, in turn, signal the policymaker’s intention to keep short rates low for an extended period of time, strengthening our forward guidance.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Moreover, by increasing the relative returns of bank loans, asset purchases also indirectly support the bank loan creation that is further buttressed by the conditionality attached to our TLTROs.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Our forceful monetary policy response announced in March 2020 was immediately followed by broad fiscal measures at national level, including, in particular, loan guarantee schemes for corporates and job retention schemes for workers.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: First, the ability to successfully counter a rapidly evolving crisis depends on the scope for innovation and flexibility in the monetary policy toolkit.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The substantial monetary easing that we delivered over the course of the crisis has put such concerns to rest.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In particular, there are important complementarities between negative interest rates, targeted lending operations and asset purchases.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Moreover, our recently revised forward guidance allows us to steer interest rate expectations even more effectively, thus reinforcing the impact of our other measures.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In line with our policy of continuously conducting thorough proportionality assessments, this also mitigates undesirable side effects associated with individual monetary policy instruments.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The final lesson from our policy interventions is that supportive fiscal policy, in particular at the European level, has played an important role in alleviating the pressure on monetary policy to be “the only game in town”.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: While the announcement of the PEPP was crucial in averting self-reinforcing price spirals in government bond markets and thus a deterioration of financing conditions at the beginning of the crisis, the political agreement relating to a joint recovery fund and the NGEU initiative was instrumental in sustainably calming financial markets (Chart 7).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The subsequent easing of financing conditions – and the investment that will be financed under NGEU – will continue to support economic activity in Europe, foster potential growth and ultimately help to bring inflation back towards our medium-term target.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Although it would be premature to claim that we have successfully overcome the crisis, the experience from the pandemic has illustrated the effectiveness of the ECB’s monetary policy toolkit in stabilising financial markets and countering the negative impact of the pandemic on the inflation outlook.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Introduction Euro area headline inflation is expected to have reached 3.4% in September according to the most recent flash estimate, its highest annual rate in more than a decade and notably above the ECB’s new symmetric target of 2% to be attained over the medium term.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The recent rise in inflation, which was at least partly expected, has intensified the debate about the most likely future evolution of price pressures – in the euro area and elsewhere.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: It stands in sharp contrast to the developments observed over the past decade when structural headwinds prevented inflation from converging towards our target.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The timing of this conference on inflation drivers and dynamics could therefore hardly be more fitting.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: I will begin my remarks by briefly discussing how the current spike in inflation can in large part be attributed to temporary pandemic-related factors that are likely to dissipate in the medium term.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Then I will turn to a more thorough discussion of the headwinds and tailwinds that may contribute to the evolution of inflation over the medium term, linking them to research that will be presented at this conference.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: My main focus will be on two important topics: inflation expectations and behavioural changes, for example regarding firms’ price setting behaviour.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: We devoted a substantial part of our recently concluded strategy review to understanding how these factors affect inflation dynamics, and continue to pursue an ambitious research agenda in these areas.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The papers that will be presented at this conference address many questions that are highly relevant in the current debate on inflation and therefore have important ramifications for the future conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Near-term prospects: an inflation sneeze Let me begin by recalling the evolution of price dynamics in the euro area over the ten years that have passed since inflation last reached levels around 3%.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Over most of the past decade, inflation has persistently fallen short of the ECB’s previous inflation aim of below, but close to, 2 percent.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Both headline and core inflation averaged around 1% between January 2013 and December 2019 (Chart 1).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Moreover, inflation repeatedly surprised on the downside relative to our in-house staff projections before the pandemic (Chart 2).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Other international institutions and financial market participants also continuously overpredicted future inflation developments.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Subdued inflation dynamics were driven by both cyclical and structural factors, which, in combination, created sustained headwinds for underlying price pressures.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: A high level of slack after the double-dip recession, diminishing conventional monetary policy space in the vicinity of the effective lower bound as well as structural factors, such as globalisation, digitalisation and demographic change, have all contributed to persistently low inflation rates.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: During our monetary policy strategy review, we conducted detailed analysis to examine the relative importance of these drivers.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Initially, the pandemic had put further downward pressure on inflation in the euro area.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Inflation declined substantially in 2020, with rates temporarily entering negative territory in the second half of the year.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: With the onset of the recovery, inflation picked up rapidly.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: In fact, the current spike in inflation owes much to the continued impact of those same factors that pushed down inflation earlier in the annual comparison.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Consequently, their impact on inflation rates will be transitory.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Indeed, more than half of measured headline inflation in the euro area, based on the harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP), is currently due to rising energy prices and the reversal of the German VAT cut (Chart 3).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Inflation has also been affected by changes in the weights in the consumption basket.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Consumption patterns changed markedly last year owing to the impact of lockdowns, leading to a shift in consumption weights that are used to calculate Eurostat’s inflation index.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: These changing weights can have a notable impact on the measurement of inflation: HICP inflation would have been even higher in recent months using last year’s weights (Chart 3).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: For example, assuming constant consumption weights, euro area services inflation would have amounted to 2.1% in September instead of 1.7% indicated by the flash estimate.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Due to the construction method of the HICP, the pandemic-induced expenditure shifts will continue to affect the index calculation until at least 2022.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Two further pandemic-related factors are also having a temporary – if somewhat more durable – impact on inflation.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: First, continued supply chain disruptions, augmented by the global economic recovery, are pushing up producer prices due to supply and demand imbalances, thus feeding into non-energy industrial goods inflation, which has been exceptionally strong recently (Chart 4, left panel).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Second, the re-opening of the economy has pushed up services inflation to 1.1% in August and 1.7% in September according to the flash estimate.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: This recent surge in services inflation is predominantly due to rising price pressures in high-contact services (Chart 4, right panel).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Speaking metaphorically, the current inflationary spike can be compared to a sneeze: the economy’s reaction to dust being kicked up in the wake of the pandemic and the ensuing recovery.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: And even though these pandemic-related developments are currently dominating media headlines, chances are high that the current episode of above-target inflationary pressures will subside over time.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The latest data and survey results, including findings on potential second-round effects in wage bargaining, do not suggest that price pressures will persist.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: At present, headline inflation is forecast to fall back below our medium-term inflation target of 2% in the medium term (Chart 5).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Similarly, core inflation is projected to rise only gradually.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The persistence of inflationary pressures ultimately depends on whether the dust kicked up by the pandemic continues to settle as the economic recovery takes hold.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: There are several sources of uncertainty that might entail more persistent inflationary pressures.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: As we form our assessment of the medium-term inflation outlook, we keep our finger in the wind to determine whether the breeze will turn out to be more long-lived than just a transitory gust.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: It is also possible that the pandemic has altered or reinforced structural trends, thus affecting inflation dynamics in the years to come.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Against the background of research contributions presented at this conference, I would like to highlight two additional, and possibly related, types of uncertainty that will determine whether current inflationary trends will turn out to be more persistent.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: First, the current uptick in inflation might result in a more enduring upward revision of expectations about nominal costs and inflation.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The role of inflation expectations Let me begin with inflation expectations.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
parole_chiave: inflation; monetary policy; price stability; wage
frase: The standard prescription for monetary policy is to “look through” temporary supply-side shocks and to only take policy action if inflation expectations and wage bargaining give rise to second-round effects posing a threat to price stability.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The difficulty with this prescription is that aggregate inflation expectations are unobservable, requiring policymakers to employ various proxy measures.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: One method is to use market-based measures of inflation compensation.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Immediately prior to the pandemic, estimates derived from market prices pointed to medium-term inflation expectations of only 1.1%, substantially below our medium-term inflation target (Chart 6, left panel).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: In that regard, the recent increase in market-based inflation expectations along the entire maturity distribution to levels closer to our target is a welcome development.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: It signals that investors have become more sanguine about the euro area inflation outlook without pointing – so far at least – to fears of more persistent inflation overshoots that could spiral back into actual price and wage dynamics.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: And since inflation expectations help to determine the real interest rate, higher inflation expectations reinforce the degree of policy accommodation in an environment of low nominal yields, and thus contribute to lifting inflation towards our new symmetric medium-term target of 2%.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The risk adjustment is based on an affine term structure model and fitted to the euro area zero-coupon inflation-linked swaps (ILS) curve.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Another method of gauging inflation expectations is to rely on survey-based metrics.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Similar to market-based measures, survey-based measures of inflation expectations have exhibited a notable uplift in the wake of the recovery from the pandemic but remain below our target (Chart 6, left panel).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: In other words, there is currently no indication that elevated inflation rates are becoming entrenched in medium and longer-term inflation expectations in the euro area, entailing risks for price stability.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: On the contrary, recent developments across indicators suggest that investors and professional forecasters are increasingly internalising our new monetary policy strategy as well as our recently revised forward guidance, bringing us closer to our inflation target of 2 percent.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: In short, we will only start raising our key policy rates once we are confident that inflation has durably converged to our target well ahead of the end of our projection horizon, and we judge that realised progress in underlying inflation is sufficiently advanced to be consistent with inflation stabilising at 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: In an environment of measurable movements in inflation expectations, insights regarding their role in monetary policy transmission remain crucial for the policy deliberations of central banks.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: In the post-pandemic context, it is particularly challenging to discern whether changes in measures of expectations indicate a more fundamental change that may durably impact the transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Recent research in this area – including several papers presented at this conference – has helped shed light on how different types of inflation expectations are formed, how reliable the various measures are, and what these findings may imply for the conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Moreover, aggregating inflation expectations as a point estimate can be misleading because it disregards the distribution of inflation expectations.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: For instance, probability distributions of inflation expectations derived from option prices show a clear shift in recent months.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Following a long period of market-based distributions of inflation expectations being persistently skewed to the downside, the probability of option-implied inflation rates above 2.0% over the next five years has recently reached its highest level since 2012 at 40%(Chart 6, right panel).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Such distributions are likely to matter even more in the case of households and businesses who often lack accurate knowledge of the official inflation rate or even the central bank’s inflation target, resulting in a wide distribution of inflation expectations.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Indeed, new survey evidence in one of the conference papers confirms that inflation expectations of US firms are far from anchored.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: For central banks, these findings highlight the importance of communicating our monetary policy objectives effectively – an important consideration in our strategy review and in our decision to adopt a symmetric inflation target of 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Another conference paper addresses this issue by presenting empirical evidence corroborating the hypothesis that central bank communication focusing on the goals of monetary policy actions is more effective than communication focusing on individual monetary policy instruments.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Microeconomic rigidities such as those stemming from wage- and price-setting behaviour have profound implications for the transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Collectively, these rigidities play a crucial but subtle role in determining the location and slope of the Phillips curve – a reduced form description of how changes in aggregate demand put pressure on inflation.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Such a change would have significant implications for the conduct of monetary policy.

frase: When inflation is below target, a flatter structural Phillips curve may imply that a greater degree of policy accommodation is required to return to target.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: In turn, a flatter Phillips curve implies that more forceful monetary policy tightening may be necessary to lower inflation that surpasses the central bank’s target.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: However, like inflation expectations, the slope of the Phillips curve is not directly observable, and estimates differ depending on the models they are derived from.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Research presented at this conference suggests that one has to be careful in the estimation of the Phillips curve relationship in order to avoid confusing a changing slope with a shift in inflation expectations.

frase: Some have argued that the low rates of inflation witnessed over the past decade have reduced the rate of price resets, since firms are less likely to find themselves significantly away from their optimal price.

frase: From 2003, the IPN conducted an in-depth study of inflation persistence and price rigidity in the euro area by analysing a broad set of macro and micro data covering the period from 1996 until 2001.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The impact of such firm-level decisions on macroeconomic outcomes has crucial implications for the transmission of monetary policy decisions to the real economy.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Hence, the paper finds little evidence that selection contributes significantly to the overall inflation response to an aggregate shock.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: From a policymaker’s perspective, it is encouraging to witness the efforts to translate the impact of micro-level distributions into macroeconomic representations of policy transmission, for example through the creation of informative statistics based on micro-level data, as done in one of the conference papers.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: These findings generate constructive input for our policy discussions on the transmission of monetary policy and, ultimately, help us to improve our knowledge regarding the underlying drivers of inflation dynamics in the euro area.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Current inflationary pressures in the euro area are driven by pandemic-related factors that can be expected to largely fade out over the course of next year.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Overreacting to such short-term volatility would be harmful and risk jeopardising the ongoing economic recovery, which is why the ECB’s monetary policy remains focused on fulfilling its medium-term price stability mandate.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Nonetheless, significant uncertainty remains as to how persistent some of the current price pressures will prove to be.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The ECB therefore continues to carefully monitor inflationary developments in the euro area, with a particular focus on second-round effects, to determine whether the headwinds that have exerted downward pressure on inflation for much of the past decade are still present, or whether they may reverse in the aftermath of the pandemic.

frase: Three types of inflation: the good, the bad and the ugly For illustrative purposes, we can identify three different types of inflation.

titolo: Patient monetary policy amid a rocky recovery
frase: The first is “good” inflation, which comes about when demand is robust, output is at potential, employment is high, inflation is converging towards 2% and inflation expectations are anchored at 2%.

titolo: Patient monetary policy amid a rocky recovery

titolo: Patient monetary policy amid a rocky recovery

titolo: Patient monetary policy amid a rocky recovery
frase: The second type, “bad” inflation, occurs when negative supply shocks raise prices and depress economic activity.

titolo: Patient monetary policy amid a rocky recovery
frase: Such inflation typically falls once the supply shock is reabsorbed.

titolo: Patient monetary policy amid a rocky recovery

titolo: Patient monetary policy amid a rocky recovery

titolo: Normalising monetary policy in non-normal times
frase: Normalisation occurs when the central bank adjusts its policy parameters as medium-term inflation approaches its price stability objective, so as to achieve this objective durably.

titolo: Normalising monetary policy in non-normal times
frase: In other words, normalisation describes a situation in which monetary policy is shifting from a stance that aims to raise the inflation path – for example, by making the policy stance more expansionary – to one that aims to cement the inflation path at the target.

titolo: Normalising monetary policy in non-normal times
frase: Normal does not mean neutral First, normalisation is not the same thing as a neutral policy stance, which is when monetary policy is neither accommodative nor contractionary for the economy.

titolo: Normalising monetary policy in non-normal times
frase: A neutral stance allows the central bank to stabilise inflation around its target when output is at potential and when there are no transitory shocks disrupting the inflation path.

titolo: Normalising monetary policy in non-normal times
frase: But if we have a situation where there are shocks depressing the economic outlook, uncertainty is high and output is still below its potential level, cementing the inflation path at 2% would require a gradual withdrawal of accommodation, so that the stimulus is reduced over time but does not suddenly disappear.
