frase: In turn, both parts of this assessment involve judgements on the impact of the monetary policy adjustments that have already occurred since December 2021.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Calibrating changes in the policy stance and monitoring the transmission to the financial system, the economy and inflation presents policymakers with three challenges.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The first is to produce a reasonable (counterfactual) forecast of where inflation would head without an adjustment in monetary policy.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The second is to develop reasonable estimates of how an adjustment in monetary policy would alter that inflation trajectory.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The third is to carefully monitor each step in this transmission from monetary policy to the economy and inflation, gathering evidence along the way on how this transmission conforms with past regularities or, if it does not, to better understand how and why the specific features of the current macro-financial environment might alter the strength and speed of monetary policy transmission.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: When inflation has been far from target for a sustained period and the process of monetary tightening has been under way for some time, there are three primary inputs into monetary policy decisions.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: First, in view of the medium-term orientation of monetary policy, the inflation forecast over the next one to three years plays an important role.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Second, the incoming information on underlying inflation constitutes an essential additional basis for assessing medium-term inflation dynamics, in view of the conditional nature, the lower frequency of production and the intrinsic uncertainty surrounding macroeconomic forecasts.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Third, especially in view of the transmission lags from shifts in the monetary policy stance to the financial system, the economy and inflation dynamics, assessing the incoming information on the transmission of previous monetary policy decisions is also necessary for the appropriate calibration of monetary policy decisions.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: My focus today is on the second input: underlying inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: The assessment of underlying inflation (which should be understood in a broad sense, including the information contained in wage dynamics and inflation expectations) should be viewed as a complementary cross-check to the inflation forecasting process.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In one direction, if the signals from underlying inflation at a given point in time support the narrative embedded in the inflation forecast, this boosts confidence levels (among policymakers, market participants, firms and households) in the inflation forecasts.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In the other direction, if the signals from underlying inflation at a given point in time are at odds with the inflation forecast, this calls for robust policy decisions that take into account the different signals coming from the forecast and the analysis of underlying inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: First, I will discuss the conceptual issues involved in analysing underlying inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Second, I will review the recent data flows that are relevant for assessing underlying inflation in the euro area.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Third, I will offer some concluding remarks on the role of underlying inflation in the setting of monetary policy over the coming months.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: To this end, measures of underlying inflation are routinely monitored.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Generally, their purpose is to obtain an estimate of where headline inflation will settle in the medium term after temporary factors have vanished.”

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In view of the major dislocations of recent years (the pandemic, the energy shock, the war), it is helpful to think of headline inflation as currently being driven by three factors: (a) pure noise; (b) a reverting component; and (c) underlying inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In particular, the economics of dislocations suggest that there is currently a substantial reverting component of inflation that is sufficiently long-lasting not to constitute pure noise but that can also be expected to fade out over the near term.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: These factors contributed to the sharp rise in inflation since the middle of 2021 and, even if there has been some easing or even a reversal in these factors, the adjustment process to these shocks is still ongoing and is not likely to come to a sudden stop.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: While the adjustment process may also affect medium-term inflation dynamics, the quantitative contribution to inflation is plausibly larger over the near term than over the medium term.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Since the peak impact of monetary policy is further out than one year, this reverting component of inflation should be less important for monetary policy than the medium-term underlying component.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Since the standard measures of underlying inflation typically make a two-level distinction between the transitory and persistent components of inflation, these standard measures should not be taken at face value under conditions in which the slowly-reverting component might be (at least partly) mis-classified as contributing to medium-term inflation dynamics.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Before turning to the analysis of the range of indicators of underlying inflation, it is also necessary to recognise that the trajectory of the underlying inflation component can be affected by shocks to the noise and reverting components of inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: First, even a pure noise shock can have a permanent effect on the price level if a positive inflation shock is not followed by a subsequent negative inflation shock.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: This holds even more strongly for a shock to the reverting component: since a sustained period of high inflation can leave a large footprint on the price level if it is not fully reversed.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In turn, a surprise permanent increase in the price level can trigger medium-term inflation dynamics through its impact on the subsequent path for nominal wages, as some unwinding of the initial decline in real wages can be expected and the wage adjustment process can play out over an extended period.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Second, especially if there is a backwards-looking component in how firms, households and financial market participants form beliefs, a period of high inflation can persistently alter inflation expectations, with a direct and substantial impact on medium-term inflation expectations.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Again, this risk is more substantial in relation to the reverting component than the pure noise component of inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: For these reasons, actual inflation outcomes and measures of inflation expectations belong in the family of indicators that are relevant in assessing the underlying inflation pressures.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In one direction, strong increases in headline inflation or an upward above-target revision in inflation expectations would reinforce upward pressure on underlying inflation; in the other direction, a material decline in headline inflation or an easing in above-target inflation expectations should alleviate upward pressure on underlying inflation.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: As inflation rose, we were confronted with profound uncertainty about how far it would go and how widely it would spread across the economy.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: And even as inflation has eased, uncertainty about its persistence has remained.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: And we have done so by building our reaction function around three criteria: the inflation outlook, the dynamics of underlying inflation and the strength of monetary transmission.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: Though we conceived these criteria when we had low visibility of future inflation, they have also helped guide our decisions as inflation has fallen and forecasts have become more accurate.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: First, it helped create robustness during our tightening phase when we were devising how far we needed to go to rein in inflation.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: Second, it has helped us practice patience during the holding phase until the signals from our inflation projections and underlying inflation are more consistent.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: The tightening phase In the early phase of our tightening cycle, our main priority amid surging inflation rates was to exit our accommodative policy stance as quickly as possible.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: But as rates rose and approached restrictive territory, calibrating our policy stance became more complex.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: We first had to assess how much rates needed to rise until they were sufficiently restrictive, and then for how long they needed to stay at that level.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: Our forecasts repeatedly underpredicted inflation by large margins, even at shorter horizons.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: From 2021 to 2022 for example, the absolute inflation forecast errors in the staff macroeconomic projections, one quarter ahead, more than doubled, largely owing to volatile energy prices.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: At the same time, the mix of shocks that emerged from the pandemic and its aftermath – rotations in spending, energy spikes, “bullwhip” cycles in manufacturing, supply bottlenecks, tight labour markets, fiscal expansion and reopening effects – heightened the risk of inflation becoming more persistent.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: We faced a highly unusual conjuncture of high inflation and declining real wages, but also rising employment.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: In turn, this process could have triggered what I referred to at last year’s conference as a “tit-for-tat” inflation dynamic.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: And we faced uncertainty as to how quickly and forcefully our monetary policy response would succeed in bringing down inflation.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: The ECB had not been through a tightening cycle for more than a decade, and there were reasons to believe that the transmission of monetary policy to firms and households might have changed.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: This is why we built our monetary policy response around the three criteria I referred to earlier: the inflation outlook, the dynamics of underlying inflation and the strength of monetary transmission.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: This approach made our decisions more robust, as the inflation path we foresaw in our projections had to be validated by data we could observe in real time and extrapolate into the medium term.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: The three criteria helped us to map out the remaining climb, allowing us to bring rates to sufficiently restrictive levels to break the persistence of inflation.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: But also, by guiding us to carefully evaluate the strength of policy transmission, they acted as a cross-check against overtightening.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: This helped us reach the decision to stop rate hikes after last September.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: Since the start of this phase, inflation has been declining consistently and our projections have been showing inflation returning to our target over the medium term.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: We now project inflation to average 2.3% in 2024, which is 0.4 percentage points less than projected in December and 0.9 percentage points less than September.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: We then expect inflation to decline to 2.0% in 2025 and 1.9% in 2026.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: And unlike in the earlier phases of our policy cycle, there are reasons to believe that the expected disinflationary path will continue.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: First, for some time now inflation outturns have been broadly in line with our expectations.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: Second, we now see inflation returning to 2% earlier in our projection horizon than before, in mid-2025, and not exceeding our target for the remainder of the horizon.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: Third, the composition of inflation is improving, as we now expect lower core inflation in the medium term.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: The other criteria are also becoming more consistent with this improved inflation outlook.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: The transmission of our monetary policy is unfolding in the right direction.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead
frase: Financing conditions have reacted strongly to higher rates, loan demand has weakened and, in turn, activity has slowed notably in the most interest-sensitive sectors of the economy.

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead

titolo: Building confidence in the path ahead

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Over the past two years, we have seen a measurable and persistent rise in real interest rates across many advanced economies, partly reversing the secular decline that started in the early 1980s.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This increase in real rates has reignited the debate among academics and policymakers about the level of the natural rate of interest, or r*, the real short-term interest rate that would prevail if the economy was operating at its potential and inflation was at target.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The question is whether the recent reversal is a sign that real interest rates will remain higher once the impact of recent shocks has faded, or whether they will return to the lows seen in the pre-pandemic era.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: In my remarks today, I will discuss two hypotheses that can help explain the fall and rise in real interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The savings-investment hypothesis argues that structural determinants of global saving and investment are the ultimate drivers of the natural rate of interest, and hence real long-term rates, which are anchored around r*.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The monetary policy hypothesis argues that monetary policy may have played a role in the persistent downward trend and subsequent rise in real interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Since r* is a theoretical construct that is unobservable, and the economy’s long-run evolution is surrounded by considerable uncertainty, financial markets often look to the central bank for informing and coordinating their views about real long-term interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: By providing long-run guidance, the central bank may influence long-term interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The implications of these two hypotheses for the role of monetary policy are quite different.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: While in the first case, monetary policy merely responds to global structural changes, in the second, it may have long-lasting effects on economic activity.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The fall and rise in real interest rates In the decades following the inflation spikes of the 1970s and early 1980s, we have observed a gradual and persistent decline in real short- and long-term risk-free interest rates globally (Slide 2).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This rise has not just been driven by an increase in spot short-term rates due to the highly synchronised global monetary policy response to the inflation surge.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: It also reflects a reassessment by market participants of the expected level of real short-term interest rates prevailing in the future.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: For example, respondents to the Survey of Monetary Analysts (SMA) expect the ECB’s deposit facility rate (DFR) to level off in a range between 2% and 2.5% over the long run (Slide 4, left-hand side).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Given an expected inflation rate of 2% over the same horizon, this would correspond to an r* of 0% to 0.5%.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: These estimates are around one percentage point higher than before the start of the monetary policy tightening cycle in December 2021, when median survey expectations and model estimates of real short-term rates were in negative territory.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Within a standard macroeconomic framework, changes in equilibrium real interest rates are determined by structural shifts in savings and investments.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: An increase in desired investment, for a given level of desired savings, puts upward pressure on real interest rates (Slide 6, left-hand side).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: In a world with free capital flows, real interest rates are determined globally, in line with the remarkable co-movement across major advanced economies.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Over the long run and without any frictions in financial markets that prevent capital from moving freely across borders, there exists a single equilibrium interest rate that clears the global capital market.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: To see this, it is useful to think about the natural rate as having two components: a very slow-moving long-run component and a more cyclical component that can drive the natural rate away from its long-run trend over a protracted period.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This is consistent with recent evidence suggesting that real interest rates have oscillated around a persistent downward trend since the start of the Renaissance in the 14th century (Slide 7).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Temporary but protracted reversals in the interest rate regime happened at times of major and persistent structural shocks, such as the Black Death in the 1350s or extended periods of war.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: As such, an ageing global population and continued subdued productivity growth may remain a drag on real interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The monetary policy hypothesis The second key explanation of the trends of real interest rates suggests that monetary policy itself may play an important role for real long-term interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This hypothesis starts from the observation that, despite its theoretical appeal, there has been little evidence of a stable relationship between real interest rates and standard proxies of the key determinants of savings and investment across subsamples over the past 150 years.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Some key factors, such as demographics or productivity, have the expected relationship with real interest rates in some subsamples but not in others (Slide 11).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The view that monetary policy may help explain these deviations, at least temporarily, is not new.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Over the past two decades the literature has studied extensively whether and how monetary policy can have long-lasting effects on real interest rates, going in different directions.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: On the one hand, overly tight monetary policy may lower investment and technological growth.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: On the other hand, persistently expansionary monetary policy may lead to the build-up of financial imbalances and contribute to zombification, reducing potential growth.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: However, the most recent literature has added an interesting twist to the debate, arguing that the most important channel of monetary policy relates to central bank communication.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Recent research documents that the descent in US real long-term yields over the past decades can be explained by very narrow time windows around the Federal Reserve’s monetary policy meetings (Slide 12).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Outside these time windows, changes to real long-term interest rates have been short-lived.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: According to this study, long-run forward guidance, as expressed by the dot plots, appears to have lowered real bond yields by around 130 basis points over the last decade.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: It shows that a 100 basis point US monetary policy shock has historically been associated with a 30 basis points increase in r* over the long run.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: As monetary policy is thought to be neutral over the long run, these findings are puzzling.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: In any case, these studies suggest that the recent rise in real long-term rates may be partly due to financial market participants interpreting the policy tightening, as well as recent central bank communication, as a shift in policymakers’ beliefs about the level of r*.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: In other words, the impact of monetary policy actions and communication may be stronger than conventionally assumed.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This would also imply that central banks have little to learn about the natural rate of interest from looking at market pricing, as we may just be looking in the mirror.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: For example, easing monetary policy could be seen as signaling a lower r*, inducing firms and households to become less optimistic about the economy.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This could negatively affect output and inflation insofar as it influences spending decisions.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The central bank may then cut rates even further, validating private sector beliefs and weakening the expansionary effects of the policy rate easing.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: In this interpretation, the inability of central banks in the pre-pandemic period to bring inflation back to target may partly have been due to self-reinforcing dynamics.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: If monetary policy easing during that period was interpreted as containing adverse information about the long-run state of the economy, the contractionary effects of the resulting feedback loops may have contributed to persistent declines in r*.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Conclusion To conclude, protracted reversals in real interest rates have occurred repeatedly in history in the aftermath of large economic, political or social shocks.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The exceptional investment needs arising from structural challenges related to the climate transition, the digital transformation and geopolitical shifts may have a persistent positive impact on the natural rate of interest.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Whether the anticipation of these investment needs has directly been driving real rates higher in recent years, or whether monetary policy has been a catalyst for the repricing, remains subject to discussion.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: It is possible, however, that the determined monetary policy response to the inflation burst may have shifted market participants’ beliefs about r*, thereby making a return of secular stagnation less likely.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Introduction My aim today is to review the ECB’s monetary policy tightening cycle.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: The tightening began in December 2021 with the announcement of the end date for our net purchases under the pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP), as well as the recalibration and subsequent phase-out of our targeted lending programme.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
parole_chiave: APP; PEPP; asset purchase; deposit facility; policy rate; restrictive territory
frase: After concluding net purchases under the PEPP in March 2022 and net purchases under the asset purchase programme (APP) in June 2022, we subsequently normalised our policy rate (the deposit facility rate [DFR] in conditions of abundant excess liquidity) from -0.5 per cent to 2 per cent in the second half of 2022, before raising rates further into restrictive territory during the first nine months of 2023 to a level of 4.0 per cent.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
parole_chiave: APP; PEPP; accommodative; monetary stance; policy rate; tightening
frase: This was an especially striking tightening campaign in view of the prevailing highly-accommodative monetary stance, which consisted of very low levels of the policy rate that had been in place over the last decade, the considerable net asset purchasing under the APP since 2015 and under the PEPP since 2020 and the scale and pricing of the targeted long-term refinancing operations.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: In late 2021, this stance was still expected to be maintained over the medium term: for instance, the median respondent in the December 2021 Survey of Monetary Analysts expected the deposit facility rate to remain in negative territory until the first quarter of 2025 and net purchases under the APP to continue until June 2023.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: It follows that, relative the path expected in late 2021, the tightening cycle constituted a major surprise.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Of course, the underlying driving force for the tightening cycle was the very large surprise increase in inflation, especially in 2022, after the unjustified Russian invasion of Ukraine.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: A defining feature is that a significant component of the stance tightening is expected to be persistent in nature, with rates only expected to descend to the neighbourhood of a more neutral level, while quantitative easing and targeted refinancing operations are not expected to be resumed.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: The aim of this lecture is to review this tightening cycle from an analytical perspective.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: The tightening cycle had two basic aims.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: First, during an extended period in which inflation was far above our target, it was imperative to unwind a monetary stance that would have been too accommodative relative to the rapid shift in expected inflation over the relevant policy horizon.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Second, given the scale of the surprise inflation in 2021-2022, it was essential to contain the propagation of the inflation shock through the subsequent price-wage adjustment phases.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: While corrective waves of price and wage resetting were inescapable, a monetary stance that ensured that demand would be dampened and that inflation would return to the target in a timely manner would be needed to ensure an orderly adjustment phase that did not risk embedding above-target inflation into longer-term inflation expectations.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: In calibrating the speed and scale of monetary tightening in the context of the post-pandemic recovery and extraordinary surge in energy prices (including due to the Russian invasion of Ukraine), several considerations were paramount.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: First, lags in monetary transmission were inevitable: it would take time for monetary policy to exert its full impact on inflation.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Second, the descent of inflation from its peak would be assisted by the reversal of some of the factors driving the inflation surge: the easing of supply bottlenecks; the likely expansion of energy supply and contraction in energy demand in response to the spectacular increases in oil and gas prices; and the gradual re-normalisation of the economy through the fading out of pandemic-related distortions in sectoral supply and demand patterns.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: That is, the calibration of monetary policy should take account the temporary nature of some of the shocks, while making sure that these temporary shocks would not convert into permanent inflation through the de-anchoring of inflation expectations.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Along one dimension, there was uncertainty about the intrinsic persistence of the inflation process.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: In addition to the standard uncertainty about the feedback dynamics by which price increases in one period would trigger subsequent price and wage increases in following periods, the scale of inflation during 2022 also led to shifts in behaviour, with firms switching to more frequent pricing resets.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: While this added to the intensity of inflation, it also held out the possibility that the overall adjustment process could be front-loaded.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Ultimately, the persistence of inflation would turn on the scale of de-anchoring of inflation expectations, which warranted close monitoring.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Along a second dimension, there was uncertainty about the strength of transmission of monetary policy in view of possible shifts in the economic, financial and monetary environment.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: First and foremost, the many years of low inflation and the strategic commitment by central banks to deliver the inflation target over the medium term provided a strong foundation for containing the inflation shock, compared to the costly de-anchoring dynamics observed in the 1970s.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Furthermore, monetary tightening could be taking hold at the same time as a projected rebound in economic activity might protect employment levels, with firms holding onto workers in anticipation of post-pandemic normalisation.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Along a third dimension, the nature of the monetary configuration also created uncertainty about the tightening process.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
parole_chiave: asset purchases; monetary stance; policy rate
frase: After many years of expanding the central bank balance sheet (which had further accelerated during the pandemic), the required shift in the monetary stance called for an exit from net asset purchases and a pull back from the longer-term refinancing operations that had pumped liquidity into the banking system, in addition to the lifting of the policy rate.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: In addition, since both balance sheet normalisation and the lifting of policy rates were simultaneously proceeding at a global level, there was also uncertainty about the strength of international spillovers in the tightening process.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: A final uncertainty dimension related to the modelling of monetary policy.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: The projected impact of shifts in monetary policy varies across these models, in line with differences in the specification of the economic and financial environment and, crucially, in the sensitivity of inflation expectations to policy actions.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Taken together, these various types of uncertainty underlined the importance of taking a data-dependent approach to the calibration of monetary policy that would take into account the evolving inflation outlook, the realised path for underlying inflation indicators and the incoming evidence on the strength of monetary policy transmission.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle

frase: I will now provide an analytical review of the transmission of monetary policy tightening to: the financial and banking systems; the economy; and, finally, inflation.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: I will also briefly draw some lessons from the tightening period for the conduct of monetary policy during the next phase of the cycle.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
parole_chiave: asset purchases; hikes; policy rate; transmission
frase: Transmission to financial markets and the banking sector Our policy rate hikes and the phasing out of asset purchases have been passed smoothly to money markets, risk-free rates, risk assets and lending rates by banks.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle

frase: Transmission via market interest rates The money market is the immediate locus in the transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Our key ECB interest rates have a direct impact on the rates prevailing in that market, while our balance sheet policies also play an important role.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
parole_chiave: interest rates; monetary policy; policy rates
frase: As we returned to our policy rates as the primary instruments for steering the monetary policy stance in 2022, the understanding in the market of how we decide the key ECB interest rates has become pivotal again.

frase: This understanding contributes to the formation of expectations of market participants about the future path of interest rates and thereby has an immediate impact on medium- to longer-term interest rates, which are particularly consequential for the economy.

frase: ECB staff analysis of euro area risk-free rates and inflation-linked swap (ILS) rates suggests that financial markets have rapidly internalised the ECB’s pattern of reaction to changes in the inflation outlook.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases
frase: Since the global financial crisis in 2008, many central banks around the world have used asset purchases when conducting monetary policy.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases
frase: In the euro area, for example, asset purchases were actively used in 13 out of the past 15 years.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases
frase: In response to the post-pandemic surge in inflation, most central banks stopped net purchases and started to reduce their bond holdings.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases
frase: As this process is unfolding, it is now a good time to start reflecting on the experience of using asset purchases and to evaluate their benefits and costs by drawing on the growing body of research on their effects on financial markets and the broader economy.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases
frase: My main message today is that asset purchases can be a powerful tool when financial markets are in turmoil.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases
frase: Why central banks use asset purchases Central banks have used asset purchases for two main purposes.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases
frase: One was to respond to disturbances in monetary policy transmission and to stabilise financial markets in periods of illiquidity and turmoil.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases
frase: In the United States, for example, the first large-scale asset purchase programme, QE1, was launched with a view to supporting market functioning after the outbreak of the global financial crisis in 2008.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases
frase: In the euro area, asset purchases were first used to revive the covered bond market in 2009, which had been affected particularly severely by the global financial crisis.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases
frase: One year later, in 2010, the ECB started to purchase securities under the Securities Markets Programme to address severe tensions in certain market segments, which had been hampering the monetary policy transmission mechanism.

frase: More recently, the Bank of England conducted asset purchases to restore market functioning after gilt bond yields rose sharply on forced selling by pension and liability driven investment (LDI) funds.

titolo: The benefits and costs of asset purchases

titolo: Sustainable finance: from “eureka!” to action

titolo: Sustainable finance: from “eureka!” to action
frase: We found, for instance, that increases in food prices following extreme heatwaves were an upside risk to price stability.

titolo: Sustainable finance: from “eureka!” to action
frase: This risk has featured explicitly in our monetary policy assessment and communication in recent quarters.

titolo: Sustainable finance: from “eureka!” to action
frase: With respect to our monetary policy instruments, in October 2022 we started tilting our reinvestments of corporate bonds towards issuers with a better climate performance.

titolo: Sustainable finance: from “eureka!” to action
frase: This enables us to avoid undue exposures to climate-related risks that are detrimental to price stability and to align the way we conduct our monetary policy more closely with the EU’s general economic policies.

titolo: Sustainable finance: from “eureka!” to action

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: Latest developments in euro area underlying inflation Underlying inflation is the persistent component of inflation, signalling where headline inflation will settle in the medium term after temporary factors have vanished.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: In practice, underlying inflation is unobservable and needs to be proxied or estimated.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: Model-based measures at the ECB include the Persistent and Common Component of Inflation (PCCI), which is constructed by estimating a dynamic factor model that extracts the persistent and common component of inflation from granular price data at the item-country level, thereby exploiting the relative advantages of both cross-sectional and time series approaches.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: Another model-based measure is Supercore inflation, which picks out those items that are estimated to co-move with the business cycle.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: These model-based measures are reduced form in nature and, among other factors, reflect the empirical contribution of monetary policy tightening to delivering disinflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: That is to say, if current inflation is above target, one reason why underlying inflation might run below current inflation is that the projected mean reversion is partly driven by endogenous monetary policy tightening that has historically contributed to the return of inflation to the target over the medium term.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: In turn, monitoring the evolution of underlying inflation is an important element in diagnosing whether monetary policy is appropriately calibrated.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: Each of the underlying inflation indicators tracked by the ECB has declined significantly since the post-pandemic inflation surges, with the range narrowing towards its historical average.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: Core inflation is the most prominent exclusion-based measure, defined as HICP inflation excluding energy and food: this edged down to 2.7 per cent in September, continuing the marked decline from 4.5 per cent a year ago.In terms of model-based measures, the PCCI today is at the bottom of the range, standing at 1.9 per cent in September and having hovered around 2.0 per cent since the end of last year.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: One challenge in interpreting standard indicators of underlying inflation is that these were affected by the past extraordinary supply shocks, as well as by temporary mismatches between demand and supply.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: As I pointed out in my March 2023 speech, it is helpful to think of headline inflation as being driven by three factors: (i) underlying inflation; (ii) a reverting component; and (iii) pure noise.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: In particular, the major dislocations of recent years induced a substantial reverting component of inflation that was sufficiently long-lasting not to constitute pure noise but that was also expected to fade out over time.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: These dislocations included the impact of energy inflation and supply bottlenecks.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: To capture their indirect impact on measures of underlying inflation, we have in parallel monitored adjusted measures of underlying inflation that “partial out” these indirect influences.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update
frase: Each measure of underlying inflation provides useful information about future headline inflation, although their forecasting performance varies.

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update

titolo: Underlying inflation: an update

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: It is straightforward that small inflation deviations that are not expected to persist do not call for a monetary policy response.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: Most obviously, lags in the transmission of monetary policy mean that it would be counterproductive to seek to respond to near-term deviations that are solidly expected to be transitory.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: At the other extreme, it should also be clear that a sufficiently large and persistent deviation from the target requires a monetary policy response, regardless of its origin.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: First, through the cost-of-living channel, the current inflation rate may influence subsequent price and wage-setting, as firms and workers respond to lower cost pressures in relation to negative deviations and higher cost pressures in relation to positive deviations.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: Second, the real interest rate channel can reinforce an inflation shock that is expected to display some persistence: if a drop in inflation today is associated with ongoing low inflation for, say, the next year or two, this translates into a higher real interest rate (nominal rate minus expected inflation) over the relevant horizon.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: In turn, this puts downward pressure on consumption and investment, adding to the disinflationary impulse.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: Symmetrically, above-target inflation that is expected to persist for some time maps into a lower real interest rate and amplifies inflationary pressures.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: Third, a persistent shift in the inflation rate can influence the formation of inflation expectations if people put some weight on simple extrapolation in forming expectations.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: Under such extrapolative behaviour, if inflation runs below target for a year or two, there is some risk that people might revise down their beliefs about the de facto medium-term inflation target.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: Symmetrically, if inflation runs above target for a year or two, there is some risk that people might revise up their beliefs about the de facto medium-term inflation target.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: Fourth, a material inflation deviation that does not trigger a monetary policy response poses a communication risk, since markets, firms and households may find it difficult to understand the reaction function if there is no reaction.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: In turn, greater uncertainty about the reaction function can give rise to higher volatility in expectations about inflation and the policy rate path.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: Given these mechanisms, a material deviation of inflation from the target calls for a monetary policy response.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: Since the cost-of-living, real interest rate, expectations-deanchoring and communication channels operate in a plausibly non-linear manner (individually and collectively), the appropriate monetary policy is also non-linear, with an incremental adjustment to mid-sized deviations but a more forceful or persistent adjustment to large deviations.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: This non-linearity is recognised in our monetary policy strategy statement, which highlights that:

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: For this intermediate category of “mid-sized, somewhat persistent” deviations, the origin of the inflation deviation should play an important role in determining the appropriate monetary policy reaction.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: In particular, an intermediate-category broad-based inflation deviation likely calls for an incremental adjustment in the monetary stance.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: In essence, this is the standard prescription of monetary policy feedback rules (such as the “family” of Taylor rules).

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: However, if the origin of the inflation deviation is a supply-driven relative price level shock, the case for an active monetary policy response is more nuanced.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: In particular, a supply shock to the relative price level of energy does not pose the same risk to medium-term inflation as a shock to domestic demand.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: While an intermediate-category shock to the relative price level of energy may visibly alter headline inflation for a substantial fraction of the projection horizon (energy comprises about 10 per cent of the overall Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)), it might not materially alter the broader underlying inflation dynamics that are most important in determining the medium-term inflation trend.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: The impact of a supply-driven relative price level shock on overall inflation also tends to have an inbuilt, self-correcting element.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy
frase: For instance, a decrease in the relative price level of energy will boost activity levels in energy-using sectors, with less slack in the economy putting upward pressure on inflation over the medium term.

titolo: Inflation deviations and monetary policy

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: Pre-pandemic disinflation eased pressure on central bank independence The broad acknowledgement of the importance of central bank independence for economic stability has been one of the most significant shifts in economic governance over the past four decades.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: Its intellectual foundations were forged in response to the Great Inflation of the 1970s, which exposed the time inconsistency problem of monetary policy: even well-intentioned policymakers are tempted to exploit short-term trade-offs, leaving the economy with higher inflation and no lasting output gains.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: The solution was institutional: monetary policy was to be de-politicised and delegated to an independent authority – one that is deliberately more inflation-averse, or “conservative”, than society at large – and it should be guided by a clear, legally protected price stability mandate.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: Central bank independence helped anchor inflation expectations.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: Inflation fell and stayed low across advanced economies (Slide 2, left-hand side).

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: From a price stability perspective, macroeconomic conditions in the period from 1990 to 2019 markedly diverged from those that had prevailed before.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: From the 1990s onwards, rapid globalisation, and the growing role of China in particular, expanded the global supply of labour and goods and intensified import competition, generating persistent disinflation.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: In their attempt to control inflation, central banks were largely pushing on an open door.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: Maintaining price stability in such an environment did not test institutional resolve in the way envisaged in the 1970s and 1980s.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: The challenge of the 2010s was the opposite: to lift rather than restrain inflation.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: That task also required resolve, but of a different kind, namely the willingness to deploy unconventional and often controversial instruments – such as large-scale asset purchases – to defend price stability from below.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: Persistent disinflation also mitigated the tension between price stability and fiscal sustainability, as historically low interest rates gave governments substantial leeway (Slide 3).

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: So, when inflation surged across the world in 2021, the key question was whether independent central banks had the courage to tighten policy even when higher interest rates could push the economy into renewed recession and worsen fiscal metrics by raising debt servicing costs.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: The verdict is clear: central banks acted decisively, reflecting what independence was designed to deliver – the capacity to prioritise long-term price stability over short-term economic and political gains.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: This was true regardless of their concrete mandates as central banks with a dual mandate also prioritised price stability when it came under threat.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: A second question was whether the credibility central banks had earned over previous decades could reduce the need for aggressive tightening – by anchoring inflation expectations and preventing wage-price dynamics from spiralling.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: The contrast with the 1970s is striking: back then, unanchored inflation expectations turned a supply shock into a wage-price spiral, requiring a deep recession to break it.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: The TPI was designed to address such vulnerabilities: countering unwarranted and disorderly dynamics that impair market functioning and hinder the smooth transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
frase: To mitigate moral hazard, the TPI sets clear conditions for the purchases of sovereign bonds, ensuring that the instrument is only used in countries that pursue sound and sustainable fiscal and macroeconomic policies.

titolo: The quiet erosion of central bank independence
